## About The Role

**Purpose**  
Design, build, test and release data solutions to support the requirements of the business. Working within the data engineering team, you will deliver robust, scalable and secure data pipelines and contribute to the modernisation of 7IM’s data platform, tools and processes.  
  
**Responsibilities**  
• Build robust and scalable data solutions that meet technical and security standards  
• Contribute to the design of data solutions in line with the architecture and roadmap  
• Design, develop, test and release robust, scalable software solutions using modern technologies and best practices  
• Develop and maintain data models, pipelines and documentation  
• Adhere to engineering standards and help keep technical debt in check  
• Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to analyse needs, propose solutions and ensure alignment  
• Contribute to initiatives that modernise technology, tools and development processes  
• Peer review code and documentation for accuracy, maintainability and supportability  
• Provide second-line support and guidance to application support teams  
• Identify opportunities for technical efficiencies and share best practice  
• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal policies  
• Other duties as reasonably required by line management and 7IM

## About You

**Experience**  
- Experience in a data engineering role, ideally within a regulated environment  
- Knowledge of the following is required:

* Modern Data platform concepts; Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Vault
* Azure Data Technologies; Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, MS Fabric
* ETL / ELT processes and designing, building and testing data pipelines
* Building data transformations using Python /PySpark
* Azure Cloud Version control and CI/CD tools, specifically Azure DevOps Service
* Analytics and MI products including MS Power BI
* Data catalogue & governance using MS Purview

- Knowledge of the following would be desirable:

* Microsoft server-based data products (SQL Server, Analysis Services, Integration Services and Reporting Services)
* Enterprise Architecture tools (e.g. LeanIX, Ardoq), Frameworks (TOGAF) and core artefacts (Capability Models, Technical Reference Models, Data Flow Diagrams

- Experience developing and implementing technology roadmaps and target state architectures  
- Experience integrating bespoke software, commercial off-the-shelf packages and third-party services  
- Demonstrable experience of migrating on-premises workloads to cloud-native services  
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills  
- Strong stakeholder management and influencing abilities at all levels  
- Commitment to continuous learning and keeping skills current  
  
**Skills**  
• Able to work independently within the data space and comfortable dealing with some ambiguity  
• Comfortable delivering to plan in a fast-paced environment  
• Excellent verbal and written communication with a proven track record of stakeholder engagement and influencing both business and technical stakeholders  
• Ability to communicate between the technical and non-technical - interpreting the needs of technical and business stakeholders, communicating how activities meet strategic goals and client needs  
• Ability to analyse data to drive efficiency and optimisation, design processes and tools to monitor production systems and data accuracy  
• Ability to produce, compare, and align different data models across multiple subject areas, reverse-engineering data models from a live system where required  
• Excellent analytical and numerical skills are essential, enabling easy interpretation and analysis of large volumes of data  
• Excellent problem-solving and data modelling skills (logical, physical, semantic and integration models)

**Qualifications**  
• Relevant degree or equivalent experience.  
• Azure DP-203 (or equivalent)  
• Certification in Data Governance and Stewardship Professional (DGSP) or similar (desirable).  
• Evidence of business experience or formal business qualifications (desirable).

**Other relevant information**  
• Experience of wealth management (including operational knowledge) would be advantageous  
• Prior experience working in Financial Services preferred thorough understanding of data security, data privacy, and GDPR required

# ****About Aalyria:****

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

## ****Role Overview:****

Aalyria's Spacetime platform orchestrates highly dynamic aerospace networks using a temporospatial Software Defined Networking (SDN) approach, managing not just routing but the physical link topology and lower-layer configuration underneath it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own execution on one of our most sensitive customer programs, work that ****requires an active TS/SCI clearance****, with a polygraph strongly preferred given the access levels involved. You'll be the linchpin between Aalyria's engineering teams and a cleared government customer, driving technical tradeoffs directly rather than simply tracking them. Engineering will look to you to make sequencing, scope, and architecture-adjacent calls, and to represent program status and risk with complete accuracy to customer stakeholders who may not always have full visibility into every technical detail.

This is a role for someone who can operate independently inside a classified environment, hold their own in a room with Staff or Principal engineers, and get things done through influence rather than authority.

## ****Key Responsibilities:****

* ****End-to-End Technical Program Execution:**** Own program planning and execution for a classified Spacetime engineering effort, driving the work through each phase of the mission and directly resolving cross-system dependencies and technical tradeoffs, not just surfacing them for others to decide.
* ****Cleared Customer & Stakeholder Leadership:**** Serve as the primary programmatic interface with a cleared government customer, communicating fluently with both technical staff and senior government stakeholders across classified and unclassified channels.
* ****Cross-Functional Orchestration:**** Run the operating rhythm, such as kickoffs, technical reviews, exec readouts, that keeps Engineering, Product, and Solutions Engineering aligned on status, risk, and decisions across compartmented and uncompartmented workstreams.
* ****Requirements Translation & Technical Judgment:**** Translate customer and mission requirements into actionable engineering plans. You should be able to read and critique a design document unaided, and reason in real time about latency, throughput, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs.
* ****Security & Compliance Stewardship:**** Handle classified information and CUI correctly as a matter of course, maintain a sound personal security posture, and follow program security and export-control (ITAR/EAR) requirements without needing to be reminded. Partner closely with the FSO and IT/Cybersecurity, who are direct stakeholders in how this role is evaluated.
* ****Contract & Financial Management:**** Own T&M or cost-type contract reporting requirements, including monthly labor, subcontract, hardware, and materials tracking at the Master Equipment List (MEL) level to support invoicing.
* ****Risk & Delivery Coordination:**** Identify schedule, scope, and dependency risk early; escalate with context; and coordinate mitigations directly with engineering leads across development, staging, and dedicated government cloud production environments.

## ****Required Qualifications:****

* ****Active TS/SCI clearance in good standing. TS/SCI with polygraph is strongly preferred given the access levels this role requires.****
* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role delivering complex technical platforms, ideally for U.S. Government or defense/space customers.
* Demonstrated technical depth: the ability to read and critique a design document unaided, and to engage engineering teams on architecture, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs as a peer, not a translator.
* A track record with genuinely technical programs, infrastructure migrations, API/interface contracts, cross-system dependency resolution, or multi-team technical rollouts, not just cross-functional coordination with a technical flavor.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and interface confidently with senior government and customer stakeholders.
* Experience managing complex project financials, resource tracking, or strict contractual reporting requirements (T&M, FFP, or cost-type contracts).
* U.S. citizenship (required to hold and maintain the clearance level above).
* Background in engineering, hardware/software systems, or solutions architecture, or a related field with hands-on experience running technical programs alongside engineering teams.

## ****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Familiarity with networking, telecom, or SDN/traffic engineering concepts.
* Strong background in satellite and mission operations — early-orbit commissioning, fleet readiness, or operating in high-consequence environments.
* Experience supporting programs that have transitioned from prototype to production volumes, and improving TRL/MRL along the way.
* In-depth knowledge of USG acquisition processes, FAR/DFARS, and contract vehicles (BAAs, sole-source, IDIQs, OTAs).
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field — preferred, not mandatory. Equivalent hands-on technical experience is evaluated on equal footing.
* Willingness to travel occasionally as program needs require.

## ****What We Offer:****

* ****Innovative Environment:**** Work at a cutting-edge company shaping the future of aerospace communications.
* ****Impactful Work:**** Directly contribute to critical national security programs and initiatives.
* ****Growth Opportunities:**** Expand your career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* ****Inclusive Culture:**** Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
* ****Flexibility:**** Flexible working arrangements including hybrid remote/in-office schedules.
* ****Compensation and Equity:**** Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits (401(k), dental, vision, health, life insurance), paid time off, and equity options.

## ****ITAR/EAR Requirements:****

This position involves access to export-controlled information. To comply with U.S. government export regulations, applicants must meet one of the following criteria:

(A) Qualify as a U.S. person, which includes:

* U.S. citizen or national
* U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder)
* Refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157
* Asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158

(B) Be eligible to access export-controlled information without requiring an export authorization.

(C) Be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization from the appropriate U.S. government agency.

The company reserves the right to decline pursuing an export licensing process for legitimate business-related reasons.

Aalyria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified applicants from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

We are looking for a Solution Architect (SA) with deep expertise in end-to-end SATCOM and 3GPP mobile network architecture, spanning RAN, Core, transport, and service orchestration, with a strong focus on 4G/5G Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and Direct-to-Cell and their evolution toward 6G, to join our growing NTN/DTC team within the Spacetime division.

## ****Key Responsibilities:****

* ****SATCOM and NTN RAN optimization, O-RAN SMO/RIC, SON & Radio Resource Management (RRM)****
* + Design and optimize radio resource management (RRM), scheduling, beam management, mobility, and interference coordination mechanisms
  + Support development of customer resource management solutions and Spacetime algorithms to be implemented by Aalyria Spacetime software engineering team
  + Address satellite/NTN-specific constraints (Doppler, delay, ephemeris, beam hopping, power limits, feeder link constraints)
  + Drive the design and support the implementation in Spacetime of advanced orchestration and resource management capabilities for Direct-to-Cell architectures, including spectrum reuse, sharing and coexistence with terrestrial MNO networks
  + Ensure RRM and Spacetime implementation alignment with regulatory and spectrum constraints (ITU-R, regional regulators)
* ****System & Solution Architecture domain****
* + Understand and, in some cases, end-to-end system architectures for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) with knowledge of the end-to-end service chain (UE → RAN → Core → Transport/SDN (inc. front, mid and back-haul) → Service layer)
  + Lead customer engagement and projects around architecture for LEO/GEO/MEO and multi-orbit satellite systems integrated with 3GPP 4G/5G (Rel-17+) and future 6G concepts
  + Own architectural blueprints, interfaces, and decomposition across space segment, ground segment, and mobile network domains, in particular in their interactions with Aalyria’s Spacetime.
  + Lead customer solution architecture, requirements collection and translation into Spacetime requirements and project execution
  + Drive technology selection and trade-off analyses, where needed
  + Drive technical proposal writing for commercial and public sector customers
* ****Standards & Ecosystem****
* + Understand, interpret and apply 3GPP specifications (RAN, SA, CT) relevant to Spacetime for NTN, SCS, and D2D and RAN OAM/orchestration (e.g. RAN3, SA2, SA5) and Mobility (e.g. RAN2, etc)
  + Contribute to or interface with standards bodies and industry forums (e.g. 3GPP, ETSI, GSMA, O-RAN, ESA NTN Forum, MSSA, etc)
* ****SDN, Cloud-Native, Network Orchestration & Automation****

* + Design network and 3GPP RAN/CN function orchestration and FCAPS
  + Define interfaces and APIs for automation, orchestration, and inter-domain coordination
* ****Delivery & Stakeholder Interface****
* + Lead specific technical customer or prospective customer engagements, proposals, including also applications to public sector grant proposals across US, UK, EU and globally (e.g. ESA, UKSA NTIA, NSF, etc) as needed, and conduct technical reviews
  + Translate high-level requirements into implementable technical architectures
  + Act as technical authority across engineering, product, and partner teams

## ****Required Qualifications:****

* Strong background in 4G/5G mobile network architecture (RAN + Core)
* Proven experience and understanding in SATCOM system architecture (space + ground)
* Deep understanding of 3GPP architecture, protocols, and interfaces
* Hands-on knowledge of RAN concepts: PHY/MAC, scheduling, mobility, beamforming, interference
* Experience producing architecture documents, system diagrams, and technical specifications
* Understanding of 3GPP APIs, RAN OAM and control plane concepts, networking protocols and interfaces
* Understanding of concepts of cloud native, NFV, orchestration and automation, network automation and orchestration APIs, etc
* Strong communication and leadership skills, ability to interface with business stakeholders in the telco, satcom and defense sectors at all levels and work collaboratively in a cross-cultural team environment

## ****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Direct experience with NTN, SCS, or Direct-to-Cell systems
* Familiarity with 3GPP Rel-17+ NTN enhancements
* Experience and/or familiarity with satellite (GEO, MEO, LEO, etc) constellations and other aerospace systems and their challenges
* Knowledge of O-RAN (SMO, RIC, xApps/rApps)
* Knowledge of GSMA APIs
* Exposure to simulation, modeling, or digital-twin tools for radio or network planning.
* Experience with network orchestration and APIs
* Software engineering/development experience or experience with scripting and/or simulation languages
* Registered patents in relevant wireless communications techniques
* Publications in journals/conferences in the field of satellite or mobile communications

## ****What We Offer:****

* ****Opportunity to lead high-impact, innovative projects in the space technology and digital infrastructure domain.****
* A dynamic, international environment collaborating with leading research centres and industrial partners.
* Competitive compensation package based on experience.
* Hybrid working policy with flexible arrangements.
* Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in space-ground integration, AI-driven networks, and cloud mission control.

* Equity

## ****Work Requirements & Location:****

**Employment type:** Full time, permanent. Hybrid, 1-2 days a week in the Manchester office.  
**Salary:** Up to £40,000 per annum, depending on experience.  
  
We're looking for a skilled and proactive Security Operations Engineer to help protect AccessPay's people, platforms and customers. This is an exciting opportunity to join our Cyber Security team, where you'll play a key role in monitoring, detecting and responding to security threats while continuously improving our security capabilities.

Working closely with the Cyber Security Manager and Engineering teams, you'll help ensure security is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle, strengthen our detection and response capabilities, and support the delivery of a secure-by-design culture. If you're passionate about cyber security, enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to work with modern security technologies, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
At AccessPay, we believe that great technology starts with great people. Recognised as one of the UK's Best WorkplacesTM, we're committed to creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged and empowered to do their best work every day.

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI-powered security tooling and automation to strengthen detection capabilities, improve operational efficiency and support proactive threat management.

* Experience working within a Security Operations, Cyber Security or Information Security role.
* Strong scripting or programming skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to build automations and integrations.
* Experience using application security testing methodologies such as SAST, DAST, SCA and SBOM.
* Knowledge of security monitoring technologies, SIEM platforms, vulnerability management and incident response.
* An understanding of security frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials or SWIFT CSP.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Experience with cloud security, security automation, Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and AI-enabled security tooling would be advantageous.

## Job Description

We are seeking an engineer to lead the systems engineering, software integration and technical delivery of DC fast charging capability across Allye's energy storage products. Its central challenge is the delivery of a product that performs safely and predictably across a large population of electric vehicles and off highway machinery. Interoperability, validation and disciplined systems thinking is required, supported by substantial hands on software capability and sufficient depth in high voltage hardware to specify, direct and challenge suppliers.

**Responsibilities**

**Systems architecture and requirements**

* Own the architecture of the charging system, from the DC bus and power conversion interface through to the vehicle coupler, including the control and communications architecture across it.
* Define the requirements and interface specifications that internal engineering teams and external suppliers work to.
* Define and document the operating envelope of the product, including supported vehicle populations, power levels, operating sequences and handled failure modes.
* Lead build, buy and partner decisions on charge controllers, protocol stacks and test equipment, and hold suppliers to the specification.

**Software and communications integration**

* Lead software integration for charging, working hands on and in conjunction with the embedded controls and application software teams.
* Implement, integrate and debug the charging communication stack, including the digital communication protocols governing DC charging sessions and the legacy protocols still present in the vehicle population.
* Own the control layer that maps a charging session onto the battery management and energy management systems, including power ramping, derating, thermal limits and state of charge policy.
* Implement remote management and monitoring interfaces to industry protocol, and the supporting communication interfaces for session management and diagnostics.
* Develop tooling and automation for test execution, log capture and fault analysis.

**Interoperability, test and validation**

* Own the interoperability strategy for the product, including the definition and maintenance of the supported vehicle matrix and the evidence base behind it.
* Specify, procure and operate the charging test and validation capability, including vehicle and charger simulation and hardware in the loop testing.
* Plan and lead structured interoperability campaigns, including participation in recognised industry test events, and convert the results into a managed defect and improvement backlog.
* Diagnose faults at protocol and physical layer, including communication link establishment, insulation and cable verification, precharge and contactor sequencing, timeout and retry behaviour, and manufacturer specific deviations from standard.
* Own the field return and failure investigation process for charging, including on site diagnosis, reproduction, resolution and verification.

**High voltage interface and safety**

* Specify the physical charging interface, including couplers, cables, cooling strategy, cable management, ingress and impact protection, locking and temperature monitoring.
* Define the DC side protection and isolation strategy, including switching and protective devices, insulation and residual current monitoring, earthing and protective conductor continuity, and touch safety.
* Own the safety case for DC charging, including hazard analysis, failure mode and effects analysis, and shutdown and emergency stop behaviour.
* Work with mechanical engineering on physical integration, cable routing, thermal management and enclosure design.

**Standards, compliance and certification**

* Ensure the product conforms to the relevant international and national standards for DC charging, electrical safety, electromagnetic compatibility and functional safety applicable in the UK and European markets.
* Support product conformity assessment and marking, and manage the technical relationship with test houses, certification bodies and notified bodies.
* Maintain a current view of the evolution of the charging standards and of emerging requirements such as automated authorisation and bidirectional operation, and advise on their implications for the product roadmap.

**Job Title:** Digital Engineering Coordinator (BIM)

We are seeking an experienced BIM Coordinator to join the Tunnels & Approaches contract on the LTC project, working within the Digital team and reporting to the Digital Engineering Manager.

This role is central to ensuring high-quality BIM data management throughout the design, construction and handover phases. You will be supporting the Digital Engineering Manager in the coordination of models from designers, subcontractors, and suppliers - with a particular focus on MEICA (Mechanical, Electrical, Information, Automation) scope.

You will work across the project to unlock the value of BIM data, supporting teams in leveraging models for quantity take-offs, 4D scheduling simulations, carbon analysis, and construction planning using our Digital Construction platform, DALUX. This is a technical, detail-focused role that requires strong BIM fundamentals, coordination discipline, and the ability to work collaboratively with designers, contractors, and digital teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

Model Data Quality and Coordination

* Liaise closely with Designers to review, and quality-assure models prior to construction issue, checking for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with project standards (including ISO 19650 and its related standards).

* Ensure design models are following the project Asset data requirements and monitor the asset tagging process prior to delivery for construction.

* Review models produced by supply chain partners and supplier. Ensure that they are all delivered in the project Common Data Environment and follows standards defined by the Exchange Information Requirements and Information Execution Plan.
* Work closely with both designers and suppliers to identify efficiency gains and apply good practices to avoid redundant work. Promote the use of parametric and data-driven modelling.
* Transfer Models from the Designers CDE to the project Digital Construction Platform, DALUX. Monitor that automated transfers are being performed effectively and flag any issues where required.

BIM Data utilisation and analytics

* Work with Digital Engineering Manager and relevant project teams to assist in data extraction and scheduling required for re-estimating or carbon calculations.
* Facilitate the use of 4D simulations on the project by supporting the planning team in their use of models.

Digital Awareness

* Promote the use of Models by all relevant project members. Ensure that the team can access models easily and are trained to use the agreed project toolset for Model visualisation.

* Perfom regular training sessions and produce training content to feed into the project Digital Learning Hub.
* Promote the wider use of digital solutions and ways of working on the project.
* Keep an open mind and manage conflict in a productive way to ensure that people feel empowered using technology rather than be overwhelmed by it.

**Essential Skills & Experience:**

* Proven experience working on construction projects (in the UK preferably)
* Proven experience in the production/management/coordination & validation of Graphical Information models on challenging construction projects
* Solid understanding of BIM principles and associated standards (ISO 19650 suite mainly)
* Familiarity with infrastructure, building services (MEP), or mixed-discipline project environments.
* Understanding of major projects workflows, processes, and team structures.
* Good technical and digital skills, with proven experience using tools such as Bentley iTwin, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Navisworks, DALUX or any other model coordination and validation tools.
* Previous experience using 4D simulations tool such as Synchro 4D will be a plus
* Awareness of key data management principles and appetite for automation
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and influence across multiple disciplines and seniority levels.

Your mission: design Diary, our production tracking and record capture product — mostly on mobile, where the capture actually happens.
The opportunity: right now, what happens on a construction site lives in scattered notes, photos, and rigid forms that nobody looks at again. Diary is our answer to that: records connected to the live plan rather than siloed, capture low-friction enough that people on site actually do it, and AI woven through so insight surfaces on its own instead of staying buried.
That's the near-term product. The longer game is bigger. We want to become the capture layer for major projects worldwide, and then build the intelligence layer on top of it — a system that can tell a project team what really happened last month and what's likely to happen next. None of that works unless capture works. Which makes the design of it a fairly interesting problem to be handed.
Most of that capture happens on mobile, out on site. The people using it aren't at desks. They're site managers in PPE, foremen sharing a tablet, engineers moving between zones with patchy connectivity and gloves on. Designing for that is a different craft from designing for desktop, and it's where the magic in this product is. It's also where the gap between our ambition and our execution is currently widest.
We want Diary to be the rare bit of construction software people are actually pleased to open. **THE LAST FRONTIER**

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.

You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.
* Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.
* Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.
* Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.
* Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle.
* Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides.
* Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs.
* Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch.
* Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.
* Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager.
* 4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages.
* Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines.
* Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly.
* A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process.
* A track record of hitting ambitious deadlines in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments.
* Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership.
* Willingness to travel to remote and extreme environments as part of the role if deemed necessary.

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* Knowledge of environmental and reliability testing (e.g. thermal cycling, vibration, shock)
* Familiarity of electrical systems to ensure a holistic approach to hardware design
* Basic understanding of RF systems and components
* Previous experience working within an R&D workshop
* Experience with satellite communications, RF hardware, or Arctic/extreme-environment systems.
* Familiarity with export control considerations (ITAR/EAR, UK export licensing) relevant to dual-use technology.
* Experience working with or alongside defence primes, MOD, or NATO procurement processes.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive compensation
* Equity: meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company
* Private Healthcare for you and your family, including dental and optical
* Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
* Mission-driven culture: focus on impact, not hours logged
* Small team, real ownership: what you build matters and ships

*\*\*Before you take time to apply, please note that at this timing unfortunately we are not able to sponsor a visa for this position*\*\*

**A note on who we want to hear from**  
We're building for one of the most demanding environments on Earth and we believe diverse teams build more resilient systems. We actively welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in engineering - whether that's by gender, ethnicity, disability, or background. If you're not sure you meet every requirement, apply anyway and tell us what excites you about the problem.

### What You'll Do

We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Marketing to serve as the strategic and operational right hand to our CMO. This is a senior leadership role. Strategic Partnership & Executive Operations

* Prepare the CMO, and at times the CEO for high-stakes internal and external moments, from leadership offsites to Board reviews.

Sales Development, Reporting

* Build and own the recurring analytics that tell the story of pipeline health to the CMO, CEO, and Board

* Partner closely with Revenue Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to keep the marketing narrative grounded in what's actually happening in the funnel.

Data, Budget & Headcount

* Own budget management and headcount planning across the global marketing organization.

Executive Presence & Communication

* Translate complex, cross-functional work into clear, executive-ready narratives and decks — this is a craft, not an afterthought.

* Represent the CMO in rooms and relationships where judgment, discretion, and polish matter.

* Prior experience as a Chief of Staff (or a functionally equivalent role) is required for external candidates

* Deep proximity to go-to-market with time spent inside a marketing, sales, or revenue operations organization, with real fluency in pipeline and revenue mechanics. Ideally has directly managed or worked alongside a Sales Development function.

* Agency, events, or PR background is a real asset — strong client-management instincts and experience building and presenting polished, executive-ready materials (including direct exposure to CEO-level audiences) translate very well into this role.

* SaaS / technology company experience valued over specific industry background — we care more about how you've operated in tech than whether you know tax compliance.

* Comfortable with frequent travel alongside the CMO (approx 25%-30%).

Why This Role Matters

This is a rare seat: full visibility into how a $1.5B+ marketing organization is being built, direct partnership with a CMO who has reshaped the function, and real exposure to the CEO and Board along the way. If you've done this job before and you're ready to do it at a bigger, faster company, this is that next step.

Total Rewards

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

# Security Control Room Officer in Security Operations - Debden Site

Loughton, United Kingdom

## Job Description

**Location**: Debden, Essex

**Department Overview**

The Security Operations team sits within the Bank of England’s Security Division and plays a vital role in protecting our people, tenants, visitors, buildings, assets and information. As part of the UK’s Critical National Infrastructure, and with responsibility for supporting the production of all Bank of England banknotes, our security environment is high-profile, complex and closely connected with law enforcement.  
  
This is an interesting and varied opportunity to join an organised, disciplined and professional team at the heart of the UK’s central bank. The Security Operations team is structured to provide flexibility, enabling colleagues to train, test and exercise while continuing to deliver essential day-to-day security operations. The team works closely with stakeholders across all business areas, making this a broad and engaging role in a unique security environment.

**Job Description**

As a Control Room Operator, you will work under the direction of the Security Control Room Shift Leader to help protect the Bank from internal and external physical security threats and support responses to infrastructure failures in partnership with others. This is a 24/7 operational role, working on a rotational shift pattern.

The role focuses on overseeing IDS and CCTV systems, managing key communication activity and applying Bank-specific knowledge to support security requirements across different business areas. You will make security decisions in line with standard operating procedures, with support from senior colleagues where needed, and may occasionally direct contractor staff.

**Role Responsibilites**

As a Security Control Room Operator, you will play a key role in helping to protect the Bank of England’s people, buildings, assets and information. Working as part of a 24/7 security operation, your main responsibility will be to monitor and respond to physical security risks, internal incidents and infrastructure failures, using established procedures and the support of senior colleagues where needed.

You will oversee key security systems including CCTV, alarms and other monitoring equipment, assess and escalate potential threats, and coordinate effective responses to a range of situations. These may include suspicious activity, protests, bomb warnings, crime, fire, flood, first aid incidents, security breaches and other emergencies.

A typical shift may involve;

* control room duties,
* static guarding,
* patrolling,
* searching,
* visitor management,
* emergency response,
* mail examination,
* building protection,
* alarm monitoring,
* CCTV surveillance and asset protection.

You will also take part in regular training, development and exercising activity to help maintain a high standard of operational readiness.

This is a varied and responsible role that requires sound judgement, clear communication, strong attention to detail and the ability to remain calm under pressure. You will work closely with security colleagues, teams across the Bank, contractors and, when required, external emergency services to support a safe and secure environment.

**You will be required to work shifts which is predominantly a 3 on / 3 off rotation, but with two additional training days per month.  This is a combination of early, late and night shifts on a rotation system.  Hours of working are approximately 9 hours per shift and for training days.**

**Role Requirements**

**Minimum Criteria**

* Proven experience working in the security industry, a control room environment, or a high-security site.
* Demonstrable experience using security systems such as CCTV, alarm systems and/or fire systems.
* Able to work a 24/7 rotational shift pattern, including early, late and night shifts.
* Able to communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing, including recording incidents and actions accurately.

**Essential Criteria**

* Demonstrates sound judgement, integrity and professionalism when handling security-related matters.
* Able to remain calm, focused and effective when responding to incidents, alarms, emergency situations or competing priorities.
* Demonstrates good customer focus and the ability to provide a professional service to staff, visitors, contractors and stakeholders.
* Able to plan, prioritise and coordinate resources or activities effectively in response to operational requirements.
* Able to follow standard operating procedures and escalate security incidents appropriately when required.
* Demonstrates flexibility and reliability in supporting a shift-based operational environment.

**Desirable Criteria**

* Holds a valid SIA Licence, security qualification or equivalent relevant qualification.
* Experience delivering a professional customer experience in a security, front-of-house, control room or operational environment.
* Experience supporting incident response, emergency procedures, access control, searching, patrolling or visitor management a

**Our Approach to Inclusion**

The Bank values diversity, equity and inclusion. We play a key role in maintaining monetary and financial stability, and to do that effectively, we believe we need a workforce that reflects the society we serve.

At the Bank of England, we want all colleagues to feel valued and respected, so we're working hard to build an inclusive culture which supports people from all backgrounds and communities to be at their best at work. We celebrate all forms of diversity, including (but not limited to) age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation and socioeconomic status. We believe that it’s by drawing on different perspectives and experiences that we’ll continue to make the best decisions for the public.

Finally, we're proud to be a member of the Disability Confident Scheme. If you wish to apply under this scheme, you should check the box in the ‘Candidate Personal Information’ under the ‘Disability Confident Scheme’ section of the application.

**Salary and Benefits Information**

This role offers a salary of £28,640 and an annual, non-pensionable shift allowance of £8,000.

In addition, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package as detailed below:

* Currently a non-contributory, career average pension giving you a guaranteed retirement benefit of 1/80th of your annual salary for every year worked. There is the option to increase your pension (to 1/65th) or decrease (to 1/105th) in exchange for salary through our flexible benefits programme each year.  The Bank has the discretion to vary standard accrual rates and dial up and dial down rates at any time and to withdraw dial up and dial down options at any time.
* A discretionary performance award based on a current award pool.
* An 8% benefits allowance with the option to take as salary or purchase a wide range of flexible benefits.
* 26 days’ annual leave with option to buy up to 12 additional days through flexible benefits.
* Private medical insurance and income protection.

Employment in this role will be subject to the National Security Vetting clearance process (and typically can take between 6 to 12 weeks post offer) and the passing of additional Bank security checks in accordance with the Bank policy.  Further information regarding the vetting and security clearance requirements for the role will be provided to the successful applicant, and information about how the Bank processes personal data for these purposes, is set out in the Bank's Privacy Notice.

The Bank of England welcomes applications from all candidates, but as a UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) approved sponsor, we have a responsibility to comply with the Immigration Rules and guidance.  As such, our ability to employ individuals who require sponsorship for immigration purposes is limited.  The Bank cannot guarantee that you and / or the role you are applying for will be eligible for sponsorship and that any application made to UKVI will be successful.  Eligibility will therefore be considered on a case by case basis.

It’s therefore really important that you fill out the work history and application form questions, as your answers will form a critical part of the initial selection process.

**The assessment process will comprise of two stages.**

## Our Digital, Risk & Cyber practice are looking for an experienced Managers, who want to build and solve, not just advise

**Digital risk, cyber security and resilience are no longer cost centres – they are where value is won or lost** 

The Jaguar Land Rover cyber attack cost the company £196m and had a £1.9bn impact on the UK economy. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.  We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave. 

We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.  We work in small teams, so you lead from the front – owning delivery, developing the people around you, and building the client relationships that open up repeat work. Quarterly promotion cycles and no quotas mean you move up when you're ready, not when a slot opens up.  

We're looking for Managers who want to own our clients' hardest problems in digital risk, security and resilience – and grow the capabilities, teams and relationships that solve them. 

Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms: 

**Digital Resilience**: helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill. 

**Digital Trust**: helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography. 

We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations. 

We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.

* **Be the trusted advisor:**Work directly with CISOs and their teams, building relationships and managing the expectations that keep delivery on track and advice landing.

### Your skills and experience

We care more about the shape of your experience than a checklist. If most of the following sound like you, we'd like to hear from you: 

* **Digital risk and cyber experience:** a strong track record in digital risk, cyber security or resilience, whether gained in consulting or in-house, and a genuine passion for the field.

* **Technology and AI literacy:**fluency in, or real curiosity about, using AI to deliver, and advising clients on securing and governing it.
* **Depth in one or more of our domains:** Meaningful experience in at least one area we operate in – particularly OT/ICS security, CAF, AI security and governance, post-quantum and cryptographic agility, or operational resilience.

**Bonus points for:**

* **Certifications:** For example CISSP, CCSP or AIGP – a plus, but no substitute for real-world experience.
* **Building tooling and automation:** Hands-on with building, not just using – for example agentic AI, Power BI, Power Apps, risk quantification models or digital twins.

## Product & Platform Target Operating Model - Manager / Senior Manager

**Our Organisational Effectiveness & Agility practice is looking for an experienced Manager or Senior Manager with experience in Product & Platform model transformation** 

We help organisations rethink how they organise, govern, fund and deliver products and platforms so they can respond faster to changing customer needs, make better investment decisions and get greater value from technology. Many organisations have made progress towards Agile, Product and Platform ways of working, but still operate with legacy project funding, fragmented technology ownership, unclear accountabilities, duplicated capabilities and governance designed around programmes rather than enduring products and services. We help clients move beyond simply introducing Product roles or Agile ceremonies to fundamentally redesign how strategy, funding, governance, technology, people and delivery come together around products and platforms. 

### What you will be doing

As a Manager or Senior Manager, you will play a key role in contributing to and leading workstreams in the design and implementation of Product & Platform operating models, working with business, digital and technology stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into practical changes to organisation, governance, funding, capabilities and ways of working.  

We are particularly interested in people who can connect the different elements of the Product & Platform model and work with clients on questions such as: 

* What should genuinely be managed as a Product or Platform?

* Where should accountability for customer, business and technology outcomes sit?

* How should Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data and Operations work together?

* What decisions should teams be empowered to make, and what needs enterprise governance?

* How should investment move from projects towards persistent products and platforms?

* How should demand and capacity be managed across the organisation?

* How should enterprise platforms operate as products for their internal consumers?

* How do we measure whether the Product & Platform model is actually creating more value?

* How do we transition from today's organisation without disrupting critical delivery?

 

**You’ll help clients with:**

* **Product and Platform Centric Operating Model Design:** Helping clients design and implement Product and Platform centric operating models, including product and platform structures, taxonomies, roles, accountabilities, decision rights, governance and persistent multidisciplinary teams.

* **Portfolio Governance, Funding & Value:** Redesigning governance, investment and prioritisation approaches to better connect strategy, demand, capacity and funding to products and platforms, supported by clear outcomes, OKRs and measures of value.

* **Ways of Working & Delivery Optimisation:** Helping organisations improve how work flows from demand and discovery through delivery and operation, strengthening agile ways of working, planning, prioritisation, team collaboration and the interaction between business, Digital and Technology.

* **Workforce, Capability & Adoption:** Helping clients define the roles, skills, capacity and capability required to operate Product and Platform centric operating models effectively, while supporting leaders and teams to adopt new accountabilities and ways of working.

* **Transition & Implementation:** Translating Product and Platform centric operating model designs into practical roadmaps, pilots and implementation plans, helping clients sequence changes across organisation, governance, workforce, funding and delivery and embed the model sustainably

**Some examples of the work you'll do:**

* Supporting organisations moving from project-centric technology delivery towards a persistent Product & Platform model, helping define target structures, accountabilities, governance, funding and transition roadmaps.

* Working with digital and technology leadership teams to define Product & Platform taxonomies, helping determine which capabilities should operate as customer-facing products, enterprise platforms, shared services or enabling functions.

* Helping product teams strengthen discovery and product management practices using customer journeys, personas, design thinking, lean start-up approaches, MVPs, value stream mapping and story mapping.

* Supporting clients to embed a product-centric model that connects strategy and investment decisions to persistent multidisciplinary teams and measurable customer and business outcomes.

* Helping define and strengthen platform capabilities, including platform ownership, platform product management, engineering responsibilities, consumption models, service expectations and relationships with consuming product teams.

* Helping redesign portfolio governance and investment processes to support more persistent investment in products, platforms and strategic outcomes.

* Designing decision rights and accountabilities across Product, Technology, Architecture, Operations, Risk and business leadership to increase team autonomy while retaining appropriate enterprise control.

* Helping an organisation redesign its Digital and Technology workforce around Product, Engineering, Data, Design, Architecture and Platform capabilities.

* Assessing the maturity of an existing Product organisation and identifying practical interventions across organisation, governance, funding, capability, tooling, leadership and ways of working.

* Helping establish Product and Platform performance frameworks combining OKRs, customer outcomes, financial measures, flow metrics, reliability and operational performance.

* Supporting leadership teams through the organisational and behavioural changes required to embed Product and Platform ways of working at scale.

### 

### Your skills and experience  We’re looking for experienced consultants and industry practitioners with a strong foundation in Product & Platform model transformation. You’ll likely bring:

* **Strong experience designing and implementing Product & Platform models** in large, complex organisations, including organisational structures, roles, accountabilities, decision rights and governance.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, designers, QA and other engineers to turn product ideas and customer needs into reliable, well-designed software. You’ll have the opportunity to work across different areas of our platform, develop your technical skills and take ownership of meaningful pieces of work from development through to release.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, writes clean and maintainable code, and is keen to continue developing their engineering skills in a collaborative and fast-moving environment.

## Key Responsibilities

1. Software Development: Build, test and maintain high-quality Ruby on Rails applications, following good engineering practices and contributing to a reliable and scalable product.
2. Feature Development: Work with Product and Engineering colleagues to understand requirements, break problems down into manageable pieces and deliver solutions that provide real value to our customers.
3. APIs & Integrations: Develop and maintain APIs and integrations that allow Bizimply to connect effectively with other systems and services. Contribute to improving the quality, consistency and documentation of our APIs.
4. Quality & Testing: Write appropriate automated tests and participate in code reviews to ensure our software is reliable, maintainable and fit for production.
5. Problem Solving: Investigate bugs, performance issues and technical problems, using a structured approach to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
6. Collaboration: Work closely with other engineers, Product Managers, QA and designers to deliver features and improvements. Communicate clearly and contribute constructively to technical discussions.
7. Continuous Improvement: Look for opportunities to improve our codebase, development processes and ways of working, and share ideas that can help make the team more effective.
8. Technical Growth: Continue developing your knowledge of Ruby, Rails and the wider engineering ecosystem, while gradually taking on more technical ownership and responsibility.

## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

### Our Technical Environment

At Bizimply, you'll work across a modern SaaS technology stack, including:

* Ruby on Rails – our core backend platform
* React – our web frontend
* MySQL / PostgreSQL – data storage
* ClickHouse / BigQuery – analytics and data
* Redis / Sidekiq – messaging and asynchronous processing
* AWS – cloud infrastructure
* Git-based development and CI/CD
* Automated testing modern application monitoring and security tooling
* Anthropic/OpenAI LLMs and API

You don't need experience with all of these technologies. What's most important is strong Ruby on Rails experience, good engineering fundamentals and a willingness to learn.

### Requirements

Essential

1. 2–5 years of professional software development experience, with solid hands-on experience building and maintaining Ruby on Rails applications in a production environment.
2. Good understanding of object-oriented programming, software design principles and fundamentals, testing, version control and writing maintainable code.
3. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and working with integrations between different systems.
4. Good understanding of relational databases and experience working with SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL or similar.
5. Experience writing automated tests and working with a testing framework such as RSpec.
6. A structured approach to diagnosing technical problems and finding practical, sustainable solutions.
7. Ability to work effectively with other engineers and cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.
8. A proactive and curious approach to learning, with a willingness to take ownership of your work and continuously improve.
9. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and coding agents, which are part of our day-to-day engineering workflow.

Nice to Have

* Experience working with React or another modern JavaScript framework.
* Experience working with AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with background jobs, messaging systems or event-driven architectures.
* Experience building or maintaining third-party integrations.
* Experience with Cypress, Robot Framework or other automated testing tools.
* Experience with mobile applications or React Native.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, LLM integrations or MCP (Model Context Protocol).
* Experience working in a SaaS environment.

### Core Competencies

1. Software Engineering: You write clean, maintainable and well-tested code. You understand the importance of code quality and can make sensible technical decisions within the scope of your work.
2. Analytical & Diagnostic Thinking: You approach problems logically and systematically. You know how to investigate an issue, identify the underlying cause and determine an appropriate solution rather than simply addressing the symptoms.
3. Ownership & Accountability: You take responsibility for the work you are delivering, communicate when you encounter challenges and see your work through from understanding the problem to production.
4. Collaboration: You work well with others, contribute to technical discussions and are comfortable asking questions, sharing knowledge and learning from your colleagues.
5. Learning & Growth: You are curious about technology and actively look for ways to improve your skills. You're interested in developing towards greater technical ownership and responsibility over time.

### What You'll Get From the Role

This is a great opportunity for an engineer who has built a solid foundation in Ruby on Rails and is ready to take the next step in their career.

You'll have the opportunity to:

* Work on a product used by thousands of businesses and their employees.
* Take ownership of meaningful features and technical improvements.
* Work across a broad and interesting SaaS technology stack.
* Learn from experienced engineers and contribute your own ideas.
* Develop your skills in APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and modern application architecture.
* Grow towards greater technical ownership and senior engineering responsibilities over time.

### Reporting Structure

This position reports to a Team Lead, who reports to the CPTO.

# Senior Account Manager

London, England, United Kingdom

## Opportunity

Brunswick Group’s Investor Brand practice is recruiting for a Senior Account Manager in London.

We are looking for a confident and highly organised client manager who can independently run smaller engagements and substantial workstreams within larger programmes. You will build trusted day-to-day client relationships, keep complex work moving and support Account Directors and Partners on larger programmes.

Investor Brand has three core engines: Financial Communications, Strategic Events and Corporate Brand. These are underpinned by our Film & Live and Design capabilities. The work is varied, from results, M&A and other significant investor moments to naming, rebrands, employee engagement campaigns, annual and ESG reporting, film, content and live experiences.

The Senior Account Manager is part of our wider account management team. You will work directly on corporate brand and creative projects, while also supporting account teams across Financial Communications and Strategic Events. You will work closely with account colleagues, Partners, strategists, designers, producers and project managers. The role has no formal line-management responsibility.

## About the Role

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

**Client and account management**

* Independently manage day-to-day client relationships on smaller engagements and defined workstreams, and support Account Directors and Partners on the largest programmes.
* Build a strong understanding of each client’s business, stakeholders and communications priorities.
* Turn client requests into clear briefs, actions and decisions, seeking senior input where the strategic or commercial judgement requires it.
* Plan and run client meetings, status calls and presentations, with accurate follow-up and dependable ownership of next steps.
* Coordinate feedback and approvals, manage expectations and raise risks or sensitive issues early.
* Work as an active member of the wider account management team, sharing client intelligence, actions and opportunities rather than operating as a separate project function.

**Integrated brand and creative delivery**

* Manage projects and workstreams across Financial Communications, Strategic Events and Corporate Brand, with regular involvement in corporate brand and creative work.
* Work across assignments including naming, rebrands, employee engagement campaigns, annual and ESG reporting, results, M&A, film and live events.
* Coordinate strategists, designers, writers, producers and other specialists so the team has a clear brief, timely inputs and shared priorities.
* Work closely with project management on scopes, schedules, budgets, resource plans, risks and dependencies, with clear ownership between the disciplines.
* Support discovery, stakeholder engagement, creative reviews, production and launch, keeping the client informed and the work connected.
* Maintain a high standard of quality control across briefs, presentations, status materials and client-ready deliverables, and keep multiple workstreams moving at pace.

**Commercial development and growth**

* Support and, where appropriate, lead proposals, pitch materials, credentials and chemistry meetings.
* Help develop clear scopes of work, fees and delivery approaches with Account Directors, Partners and project managers.
* Track scope, budget and resource use with the project management team, and flag changes or pressure points early.
* Identify follow-on needs and wider client opportunities, and raise them with the relevant account lead.
* Contribute to account plans, pipeline updates, case studies and practice-wide new business activity.

**Collaboration and practice contribution**

* Build strong working relationships across account management, Investor Brand, Brunswick’s advisory teams and the wider global firm.
* Bring a practical, solutions-focused approach and communicate clearly when priorities, decisions or responsibilities are unclear.
* Share useful knowledge and support colleagues through project work, while continuing to develop your own strategic and commercial judgement.
* Contribute ideas and learning that improve our client experience, our offers and the way multidisciplinary teams work together.

## What We’re Looking For

* Strong experience in account or client management within a brand, design, creative or corporate communications agency or consultancy.
* A track record of independently managing projects or substantial workstreams from brief through delivery.
* Experience in corporate brand, identity or creative campaigns, with exposure to Employee Engagement, Annual & ESG Reporting, film, content, investor communications or events an advantage.
* Confident and credible with clients, including the ability to listen well, ask good questions and communicate clear recommendations.
* Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of the wider objective.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefs, proposals, status updates and presentations.
* Sound commercial awareness and experience working with scopes, budgets and change control.
* A good understanding of how strategy, design, content and production come together to deliver effective corporate communications.
* A collaborative, proactive and calm working style, with the confidence to raise issues early and ask for support when needed.
* Experience in a leading agency environment, or with listed and high-profile organisations, is desirable but not essential.

## Why Join Us

Whether you are joining a client facing team, a core services team, or starting out on your professional career journey, joining Brunswick unlocks a range of employee benefits to support your financial future, health and wellness, family and community and continuous professional development.

# About Brunswick

Brunswick is a global advisory firm. We help companies tackle high-stakes issues, navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and deliver high-impact outcomes.

Our clients value our ability to anticipate, shape, and respond to the key players and forces in the financial and investment arena, regulatory and geopolitical universe, NGO community, workforce and beyond. They rely on us for deep experience, fresh perspectives and original thinking. So, in Brunswick you will find an exceptional range of experience and talent with a rich mix of backgrounds. From the beginning, we have prioritized attracting, developing, and retaining the best professionals in the industry, united by a culture of inclusivity, excellence, and intellectual curiosity.

Founded in 1987 in London, the firm has organically grown to 27 offices in 18 countries across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia. We operate as a “one-firm firm” with no individual profit centers. This allows us to assemble fully integrated, bespoke teams for each client, able to draw on the full resources of Brunswick anywhere in the world.

*Brunswick is an equal opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. Please read our Global Privacy Notice to understand how your data is managed.*

Promote a culture of responsible data and AI usage across the organisation.

We're interested in talented governance professionals who bring a blend of strategic thinking, technical understanding and stakeholder influence.

Significant experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Risk, AI Governance or a related discipline.
Experience implementing governance frameworks, controls and assurance processes.
Proven experience managing governance and risk within regulated environments such as Insurance, Financial Services, Banking or Healthcare.
Knowledge of governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK, DCAM or similar.
Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews and compliance activities.
Experience implementing Responsible AI principles, governance frameworks or model risk controls.
You'll Also Have
Strong understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage and data lifecycle management.
Knowledge of governance technologies including data catalogues, metadata and data quality platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
The ability to influence senior leaders and drive organisational change.

Capstone is looking to appoint a Risk Engineer at Associate or Vice President level within Risk Technology. This is a hands-on role combining software engineering, risk and financial markets, with direct exposure to the investment process. You will design and build investment-facing risk and decision-support capabilities, remaining close to the code, data and users from initial problem through to production.

This is an opportunity to build the technology behind Capstone’s Risk Intelligence strategy - turning complex risk and portfolio data into timely, actionable intelligence. You will develop tools that help Portfolio Managers and Risk Managers understand what changed, what drove it and what action to consider across stress scenarios, risk factors, margin, liquidity and portfolio analytics. The work will directly support sizing, trade expression, hedging, portfolio construction and capital allocation - helping drive better decisions, more efficient capital and more repeatable alpha.

About the Company 

Cnuic Technologies is a deep-tech company based in Edinburgh. We are building next-generation optical systems aimed at pushing the limits of precision manufacturing and nanoscale engineering. We are backed by substantial venture capital and have received grant support from several UK innovation agencies. 

We are a small, focused team working on genuinely difficult hardware problems. The work is fast-paced and collaborative, and we give engineers the space and resources to do serious technical work. If you want to build something from the ground up and care deeply about getting the physics right, this is a good place to be. 

About the Role 

This is a principal-level engineering role focused on the design and development of metasurface  
enabled optical systems. You will be working at the intersection of electromagnetic theory, nanophotonic simulation, and macro-scale optical design, taking ideas from first-principles. 

At the core of this role is a deep understanding of how light interacts with matter at sub-wavelength scales. You will design and simulate metasurfaces and metamaterials using rigorous electromagnetic methods, manage the coupling of light from macro-scale optical systems into metastructures, and ensure that designs are both physically sound and fabrication-compatible. 

You will own the end-to-end optical and nanophotonic simulation workflow. This means using Lumerical FDTD and RCWA for unit cell and structure-level electromagnetic analysis, carrying out dispersion analysis and effective medium theory (EMT) modelling, and then bridging to macro-scale system behaviour using Zemax or equivalent ray tracing tools. You will define tolerances, validate against experimental data, and iterate. 

This is a lead role, so you will also help set technical direction for the optics team and work closely with colleagues across simulation, hardware, and systems engineering. 

About You 

* You are comfortable working independently and taking ownership of an open-ended technical problem without a detailed brief.

* You can communicate complex photonics concepts clearly to engineers from other disciplines and to leadership.

* You are happy to defend technical decisions in design reviews and take critical feedback constructively.

* You are comfortable in a startup environment where priorities evolve as experimental results come in.

Technical Requirements 

Electromagnetic Simulation and Nanophotonics 

* Strong, hands-on experience with Lumerical FDTD for sub-wavelength structure simulation, including metasurface unit cell design, near-field analysis, transmission/reflection spectra, and phase response characterisation.

* Solid grounding in electromagnetic theory relevant to nanophotonic design: effective medium theory, dispersion analysis, Mie resonances, and coupled-mode theory as they apply to dielectric and hybrid metal-dielectric metastructures.

* Experience designing and optimising metasurfaces for functional optical properties, such as spectral filtering, phase control, or polarisation manipulation.

* Familiarity with RCWA (rigorous coupled-wave analysis) as a complementary simulation method to FDTD for periodic structures.

Optical System Design 

* Working knowledge of Zemax  
  OpticStudio (or equivalent ray tracing tools such as Code V) for macro-scale optical system design, including modelling of light coupling from bulk optical components into metasurface or nanophotonic structures.

* Understanding of how to represent  
  metasurface phase and amplitude response within a ray tracing environment, and how to iterate between the nano-scale and system-level simulations to optimise integrated performance.

* Experience with tolerance analysis, aberration management, and the practical constraints of manufacturing and alignment.

Benefits & Compensation  

We offer a competitive salary appropriate to a principal-level role. In addition: 

* Equity: A meaningful allocation from our option pool, reflecting the foundational nature of this hire.

* Life insurance: Standard comprehensive coverage.

* Office: A well-equipped, modern workspace in West Edinburgh, designed for both focused individual work and team collaboration, with dedicated areas to step away and recharge.
