# **About Us**

Founded in the US in 2022 and now based in London, UK, Recraft is an AI tool for professional designers, illustrators, and marketers, setting a new standard for excellence in image generation.

We designed a tool that lets creators quickly generate and iterate original images, vector art, illustrations, icons, and 3D graphics with AI. Over 3 million users across 190+ countries have produced hundreds of millions of images using Recraft, and we're just getting started.

Join a universe of professional opportunities, develop and support large-scale projects, and shape the future of creativity. We are committed to making Recraft an essential, daily tool for every designer and setting the industry standard. Our mission is to ensure that creators can fully control their creative process with AI, providing them with innovative tools to turn ideas into reality.

If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, we want you on board!

## **Job Description**

Growth at Recraft is a numbers problem before it's a brand problem. We're looking for a UA Manager who owns paid acquisition end to end: setting up the channels, scaling spend without breaking payback, and knowing which lever moved the number. This is a hands-in-the-accounts role, not an agency-management one — and for the right person, a chance to build the performance marketing engine at Recraft from scratch and scale it toward $1M/month.

One thing to know about the model, because it shapes the job: we don't run a free trial. New users get a pack of free credits, and once they need more, the only way forward is a paid subscription. That means conversion often happens on day one, and the numbers that matter are free-to-paid conversion rate, renewal, and payback by cohort — not trial starts.

## **Key Responsibilities**

* Own paid user acquisition on Meta first — account structure, targeting, bidding, budget pacing, and daily optimization. Meta is where the majority of the budget sits and where we expect the majority of your time to go.
* Open and scale the next channels as Meta matures: Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, App) and TikTok.
* Scale monthly spend aggressively while holding CAC, ROAS, and cohort payback targets. Growth without payback discipline doesn't count.
* Build what isn't there yet: tracking, attribution, naming conventions, dashboards, and reporting — so decisions are made on data everyone trusts.
* Own subscription economics, not vanity metrics: free-to-paid conversion, day-one subscription rate, renewal and churn by month, ARPPU, and LTV by cohort and by channel.
* Run a structured testing cadence on audiences, placements, bidding, and offers — and brief creative based on what the data says, working directly with our Creative Designer.
* Automate the repetitive parts of the job — reporting, pacing, anomaly alerts, creative rotation — using Claude and platform APIs, so your time goes to decisions rather than spreadsheets.
* Forecast and plan budget, and report weekly on spend, CAC, and payback to marketing and leadership.

## **Who You'll Work With**

You'll join the Marketing team and work closely with our Performance Marketing Manager, Creative Designer, and the analytics and product teams. This is a role built around owning a number and bringing your own plan for hitting it, not executing someone else's media plan.

## **Requirements**

* 4+ years in user acquisition or performance marketing for a consumer subscription product — app, web, or both.
* Deep, hands-on Meta expertise. You've run Meta as a primary acquisition channel at meaningful spend, built the account structure yourself, and can explain how you handled the moments where scaling stopped working.
* You've managed a paid budget of at least $100k/month and can walk us through what CAC and payback did as you scaled it.
* Experience setting up performance marketing from scratch — accounts, pixels and server-side events, MMP/SKAN or GA4, attribution logic, and reporting.
* Fluency in subscription economics: free-to-paid conversion, renewal and churn, ARPPU, LTV:CAC, and cohort payback. Comfortable pulling your own numbers in a BI tool, with basic SQL.
* Comfortable using AI in your daily workflow — analysis, reporting, and automation — rather than treating it as a side experiment.
* Based in the EU, Georgia, Armenia, or Serbia, with the right to work as a contractor there.

## **Nice to Have**

* **A track record of scaling paid spend to around $1M/month.** This is a significant plus and would move a candidate to the top of the list. We know it's rare, which is why it sits here rather than in requirements.
* Experience with a credit, token, or usage-based subscription — a model where conversion is driven by hitting a limit rather than by a trial expiring.
* Hands-on experience beyond Meta — Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, App), TikTok, or Apple Search Ads. Strength in a second channel counts for a lot; all of them is not something we expect.
* Experience in the photo, video, or creative-tools segment (Canva, Picsart, Photoroom, VSCO, CapCut-adjacent products) — or another consumer subscription category with hard payback math, such as fitness, health, or education.
* Real experience using Claude or other LLMs to manage and automate performance campaigns: bulk edits, budget pacing scripts, automated creative and cohort reporting.
* Both web and app funnel experience, including web-to-app flows and web paywalls (Stripe, Paddle, or similar).
* Incrementality testing, geo-lift — anything that shows you're skeptical of platform-reported numbers.
* Ad copywriting — able to write your own hooks and headlines instead of waiting on a brief.
* In-house experience at a product company rather than purely agency-side work.
* You're already a Recraft user.

## **What We Offer**

* A full-time contractor engagement, fully remote, with compensation that matches the seniority and ownership this role carries.
* Real ownership of the acquisition budget and the targets attached to it — you set the plan, you spend the money, you own the result.
* A product built on AI image and video generation, growing fast, where your work has a direct, measurable line to company revenue.
* The chance to define what performance marketing looks like at Recraft — the structure and playbook you build is what everyone after you works from.
* An environment where automating your own job with AI is encouraged, not viewed with suspicion.
* Direct collaboration with our Performance Marketing, Creative, analytics, and product teams.
* A team that means it when it says it wants to build the best product in the category — people who give each other direct, useful feedback, share context openly, and step in to help without being asked.

**Security & Compliance Specialist**

As a key member of Rightmove’s Security and Compliance Team, you will play a vital role in safeguarding the integrity and trustworthiness of our platform. Your primary responsibilities will include monitoring, responding to, and investigating fraudulent activities that impact Rightmove, our partners, and consumers. Additionally, you will be the frontline support for GDPR-related requests, such as Subject Access Requests, Right to be Forgotten requests, and Unsubscribe requests.   
 

You will also be instrumental in ensuring that new customers and existing members adhere to industry standards and Rightmove’s terms and conditions. This includes conducting compliance and security vetting for all new joiners, as well as reviewing and cross-referencing members expelled from compliance schemes. Collaboration with our Legal team will be essential to maintain Rightmove’s reputation as a trusted resource for home movers and estate agents. 

**What you’ll be doing** 

* Monitoring the Fraud Report to identify potential fraudulent activity;

* Monitoring our Fraud and DPO inboxes;

* Monitoring our image alert channel to ensure no personal or sensitive data has been uploaded to our site;

* Investigating reports of fraud from our partners, consumers and other Rightmovers;

* Reporting confirmed cases of Fraud and Data Breaches to the necessary Regulatory bodies (where appropriate);

* Investigating, recording and reporting Data Breaches within deadlines set by the ICO;

* Completing data requests from consumers, partners and Rightmovers to ensure we remain GDPR compliant;

* You’ll be the first point of call for sometimes difficult conversations which could be as a result of us removing a compromised branch or locking user accounts;

* Suggesting areas for improvement.  Working alongside the Security and Compliance Team Leader, you’ll suggest ways to improve existing processes striving for the best service for our partners, consumers and Rightmovers alike;

* Sharing responsibility of monitoring our DPO and Fraud inboxes, as well as the Fraud Report, outside of working hours and responding to urgent incidents efficiently and effectively.

**Who you are** 

* Accurate and methodical with high standards, an excellent eye for the detail.

* Is a clear and effective communicator in both written and verbal form, who is confident in speaking to different people internally and within our partners business.

* Strong time management and ability to prioritise and manage your day self-sufficiently, often spinning multiple plates.

* Comfortable working under pressure in a calm manner

* Is empathetic and caring to customer needs and expectations, believes ‘good enough is never good enough’ and understands how you contribute to Rightmove

* Is an excellent team player, loyal, reliable and punctual.

* Adaptable when needed and appropriate. Can demonstrate a growth mindset.

**What you’ll bring to the role** 

* A curious nature

* The ability to remain calm in pressurised situations

* Analytical skills

* The ability to be decisive

* Excellent record keeping skills

* Confidence to ask difficult questions

* Sound judgement calls

* A good understanding of GDPR regulations and why they are in place

* Experience of using Microsoft office, particularly Outlook, Excel and Word

Salesforce is seeking a Senior Incident Responder for our Cyber Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) with a passion for Information Security and a strong understanding of digital forensics, incident response and security monitoring.

·       Exceptional communicator: you can write a crisp exec summary and walk into a room with a VP of Product to make a product case — on the same day.

**Revenue recognition is about to get a lot more interesting.** As we shift from license-based to subscription and AI consumption revenue models, the rulebook for "when is revenue actually revenue" is being rewritten in real time — and we need someone who can write it. If you want a seat at the table where deals get shaped before they're signed, not just booked after the fact, this is that seat.

**Location & working model:** Holon, Hybrid

The Revenue Accountant is the organization's technical authority on when and how revenue is recognized — a role whose importance is amplified dramatically by this shift. Applying ASC 606/IFRS 15 to an evolving portfolio of multi-element contracts — combining SaaS licenses, implementation services, professional services, and usage-based AI consumption fees — you'll ensure revenue recognition is technically correct, consistently applied, and free of restatement risk. You'll also serve as the pre-signature checkpoint for commercial contracts, reviewing non-standard deal structures before they're executed.

##### **Scope & Accountability:**

##### **Revenue Recognition & Technical Accounting**

* Apply ASC 606/IFRS 15 to the organization's contract portfolio — performing multi-element arrangement analysis, identifying and allocating standalone selling prices, and determining the appropriate timing and amount of revenue recognition for each performance obligation.
* Monitor the evolving portfolio of subscription, AI consumption, and professional services arrangements for revenue recognition implications, proactively identifying contract structures or business model changes that create new technical accounting questions.
* Develop, maintain, and communicate revenue recognition accounting policies and procedures across the finance and commercial functions, ensuring consistent application as the organization's contract portfolio evolves through the SaaS transition.

##### **Revenue Close & Reporting**

* Execute revenue recognition-specific month-end close activities: preparing revenue recognition schedules, reconciling deferred revenue accounts, booking revenue journal entries, and producing the revenue management report for financial management review.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring revenue recognition calculations and schedules through ERP-native functionality or specialist revenue recognition platforms, reducing manual effort and improving close-cycle consistency.

##### **Deal Desk & Pre-Signature Review**

* Review non-standard commercial contracts submitted through the Deal Desk approval workflow, assessing revenue recognition implications and providing written guidance before contract execution.
* Serve as the technical accounting checkpoint in the commercial approval process for non-standard deal structures.

##### **Controls & Audit**

* Manage the relationship with external auditors on revenue recognition matters, preparing technical accounting memos, providing audit support workpapers, and resolving revenue accounting queries during audit cycles.
* Administer Sarbanes-Oxley or equivalent internal controls compliance requirements specific to the revenue recognition process, ensuring that controls are designed, documented, and operating effectively.

##### **Your experience & profile:**

* Strong technical grounding in ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition, ideally within enterprise SaaS or software environments.
* Experience with multi-element arrangements, standalone selling price analysis, and complex contract structures.
* Comfortable operating as a pre-signature technical checkpoint, partnering with Deal Desk, Sales, and Legal.
* Experience managing external audit relationships and SOX (or equivalent) controls for revenue processes.
* Familiarity with ERP-native or specialist revenue recognition platforms and an interest in automating manual close activities.

We fuel our lending through customer deposits, which we attract by delivering a premium experience, choice and consistently great value to smart savers.

This combination not only allows us to deliver excellent customer experiences, but to do so efficiently and at scale.  We are proud of our innovative and agile culture, which drives consistently high employee engagement scores and makes Shawbrook an attractive destination for the best talent. If you’re willing to roll up your sleeves, contribute new ideas and believe anything is possible, you’re our kind of person.

Work with us because you:

* Want to be part of a bank built for the dynamics of the modern world
* Relish a challenge and enjoy a fast-paced, innovative and hardworking culture
* Enjoy finding new and better ways to solve complexity and make things happen
* Want to belong to a diverse culture that stands shoulder to shoulder with minority and underrepresented groups
* Care about society and the environment and want to be part of a business that cares too
* Want to continue to grow professionally and be the best version of yourself

## The Role & Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic, delivery-focused professional to join our CTO function as a Delivery Manager supporting a portfolio of change across the Digital Bank and Commercial franchises. This role will lead cross-functional squads delivering both customer-facing and internal change — ranging from digital platform enhancements to AI-powered automation.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Risk, and Business teams to deliver initiatives safely, compliantly and at pace — in line with Shawbrook’s Change Delivery Policy (v14) and associated standards.

This is a hands-on role designed for a delivery leader who can manage hybrid change across a regulated environment — combining traditional governance with modern agile execution, and supporting the safe rollout of emerging technologies including artificial intelligence and automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Delivery Execution*

* Lead the day-to-day delivery of complex initiatives across the Digital Bank and Commercial franchises, with an AI first mentality.
* Apply agile, hybrid or waterfall delivery methods depending on initiative scope, while ensuring compliance with Shawbrook’s governance standards.
* Support 1–2 cross-functional squads, working closely with Product Owners and Tech Leads to align on delivery scope, sequencing, and readiness.
* Maintain short-term planning horizons (typically 0–6 months), and manage sprint, milestone, and release cadence.
* Proactively manage blockers, dependencies, and risks across internal and third-party teams.

*Governance & Control*

* Ensure all delivery is compliant with the Change Delivery Policy, including mandatory artefacts (RAID logs, Impact Assessments, Test Approaches, Run Books, Steering Packs).
* Maintain high delivery hygiene: RAID logs updated weekly, stakeholder updates accurate and timely, decisions clearly recorded.
* Own SteerCo-level reporting inputs and ensure appropriate stakeholder alignment.
* Support Go / No-Go readiness for relevant releases, including risk assessments, roll-back plans and delivery of required artefacts.

*AI & Emerging Tech Enablement*

* Partner with Product, Data Science, Engineering and Control Functions to support the delivery of AI initiatives as they embed into core journeys.
* Understand delivery implications of AI/ML models, automation tools, or third-party integrations and ensure the same standards of change control and testing are upheld.
* Ensure risks (e.g. model risk, privacy, explainability) are logged, understood, and mitigated via appropriate collaboration with Risk and Compliance.

*Team Support & Coaching*

* Foster an environment of psychological safety, collaboration and continuous improvement within squads.
* Facilitate sprint rituals and retrospectives; champion agile ways of working tailored to squad maturity.
* Work with Senior Delivery Managers and Heads of Delivery to elevate delivery practice and maturity across the function.

## The Person

**Skills & Experience**

*Essential*

* Proven track record delivering technology and business change in regulated environments, ideally Financial Services.
* Hands-on experience managing cross-functional squads or teams delivering digital products or platforms.
* Knowledge of agile, waterfall and hybrid delivery methodologies and ability to flex between them depending on the context.
* Strong understanding of delivery governance and control frameworks — RAID logs, SteerCo reporting, Go / No-Go readiness.
* Comfortable working in regulated change environments (e.g. PRA SS1/21, FCA Consumer Duty).

*Desirable*

* Exposure to AI or data-led initiatives (e.g. automation, NLP, ML model deployment, decisioning tools).
* Understanding of AI risk considerations (e.g. model explainability, privacy, bias).
* Experience working with cloud-based platforms, third-party integrations, or large-scale platform change.

*Key Attributes*

* Highly structured, calm under pressure, and excellent at managing ambiguity.
* Proactive, accountable and delivery-focused — owns outcomes, not just ceremonies.
* Builds trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong communicator — keeps delivery transparent, pragmatic, and business-aligned.
* Passionate about continuous improvement and pragmatic agility.

## Reward

Your Wellbeing - We take your health and well-being very seriously by providing a range of benefits to give you and your family peace of mind. These include:

* Market leading family friendly policies such as access to our Maternity, Adoption and Paternity policies from Day 1 of your employment
* Free access to Headspace, a mindfulness & meditation digital health app
* Free access to Peppy digital health app that offers personalised support through fertility treatment becoming a parent or menopause
* EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) - Offering you support on a wide range of subjects including financial concerns, mental wellbeing and more general queries around family, work, housing, and health
* Cycle to work scheme
* Discounts on gym membership
* Contributory pension scheme & death in service

Your Lifestyle - It’s important you strike the right balance between your work and personal life. We provide benefits to support you when at work and when you’re enjoying your leisure time.

* Minimum of 25 days holiday per year
* Option to buy or sell holiday days through our flexi-holiday scheme
* Discounts on gym membership nationwide
* Access to discounts on a range of high street and online brands
* Community support and charitable giving

Your Contribution - We’re focused on rewarding those that go the extra mile in helping us achieve our goals.

* Participation in our annual discretionary bonus scheme designed to reward your contribution to our success
* Proudly Shawbrook recognition scheme focused on recognising our role models and thanking our colleagues for a job well done

# Head of Digital, Computing and Software Operations

At the SKAO we are coordinating a global effort to deliver one of the largest science facilities on the planet. The SKAO telescopes will be next-generation instruments that will help to answer key questions in astrophysics, drive technological innovation and support human capital development.

More than a dozen partner countries and over a thousand scientists and engineers around the world are already on board, making the SKA project an international collaboration like no other, and one of the most ambitious science and engineering endeavours of the 21st century.

Headquartered in the UK, with telescope sites in Australia and South Africa, the SKAO will be one observatory operating two telescopes, an endeavour spanning three continents. Multinational by design, in early 2021 the SKAO became an intergovernmental organisation, one of only a select handful of science infrastructures to do so worldwide.

Our Global HQ is located near the buzzing city of Manchester at the historic Jodrell Bank Observatory, a UNESCO World Heritage site located in the Cheshire countryside. It is home to a rapidly expanding international team of more than a hundred, working in a highly collaborative and inclusive way, in coordination with SKAO teams in Australia and South Africa as part of a global astronomy and engineering community.

Being part of Team SKA means contributing to something extraordinary: a uniquely exciting project to advance human knowledge that will last for decades. In return, we offer a diverse multicultural working environment, 30 days annual leave plus public holidays, a generous pension scheme, visa and support with relocation (if applicable), regular social events, a family-friendly environment and much more. Come and join us!

The Head of Digital, Software and Computing Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the computing, software, data-platform, network and digital service capabilities required to deliver the SKAO mission through late construction, commissioning and into stable observatory operations.

The role exists to ensure that SKAO’s software, platforms, networks and digital services are secure, resilient, supportable and fit for long-term scientific operations across the Observatory’s international footprint.

The postholder operates as the Head of Profession for the Technology area of the Engineering and Technology Job Family, with clear accountability for setting the operating model, standards, priorities and delivery expectations for in-scope services and platforms.

## The Role

The SKA Observatory (SKAO) is a next-generation international radio astronomy facility with telescopes in Australia and South Africa and headquarters in the United Kingdom. It is moving through the final years of construction into commissioning and operational maturity.

This role sits at the junction of programme delivery, observatory operations, scientific enablement and enterprise digital services. It spans telescope software, observatory computing and networks, science data platforms and interfaces to the SKA Regional Centre Network (SRCNet), cyber security leadership, and the digital services required to support a global observatory.

The postholder leads a federated, multinational function of approximately 130 staff across multiple countries, working through a mixture of direct line management, functional leadership, standards-setting and cross-site alignment.

As Head of Profession for Computing and Software across SKAO, this role provides visible leadership to the professional cohort, setting clear standards and direction, shaping capability, career development, succession planning and future skills needs across the function.

## Key Responsibilities, Accountabilities and Duties

Key Accountabilities

Strategy, Operating Model and Transition to Operations

* Define and maintain the observatory-wide strategy, operating model and roadmap for digital, software and computing services.

Technology Governance, Reliability and Security

* Own architecture governance, technical standards and technology roadmaps across the function.
* Ensure critical services are reliable, secure, maintainable, observable and resilient.
* Lead cyber security for the digital and software estate in partnership with relevant assurance and governance functions.

Platforms, Infrastructure and Science Enablement

* Provide accountability for the lifecycle management of observatory software, computing, network and digital service capabilities.
* Oversee capacity, performance and availability planning for critical compute, storage and network services.
* Provide strategic leadership for SRCNet-related interfaces – together with the SRCNet Project Lead – and SKAO-side platforms and services supporting science users and science data products.

Organisation, Suppliers and Financial Stewardship

* Lead workforce capability, succession planning and organisational design within the function.
* Own vendor and partner management for relevant software, infrastructure and service contracts.
* Lead budget planning, investment prioritisation and whole-life cost management for the function.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and communicate the strategy, operating model and roadmap for computing, software, data platforms and digital operations across SKAO.
* Lead the transition from construction and commissioning into sustainable operations, including service acceptance, support models and lifecycle ownership.
* Establish and maintain appropriate architecture governance, technical standards and design authority arrangements.
* Ensure that telescope software, observatory platforms and supporting infrastructure are reliable, secure, maintainable and fit for scientific operations.
* Lead the observatory approach to platform engineering, DevSecOps, release governance, observability and automation.
* Define the service-management approach for in-scope services, including service ownership, support, incident, problem, change, continuity and disaster recovery arrangements.
* Work with science, operations, programme and engineering stakeholders to translate mission priorities into technology and service roadmaps.
* Provide strategic leadership for SRCNet-related technical interfaces – together with the SRCNet Project Lead – and the SKAO-side platforms and services that support science users and science data products.
* Oversee computing infrastructure strategy, including storage, compute, networking and data lifecycle management.

* Provide regular decision-oriented reporting on delivery, service health, cyber posture, workforce capability and investment needs.

## Mandatory Knowledge, Skills and Experience

* Degree-level qualification in a relevant discipline, or equivalent senior professional experience.

* Experience leading a major function or organisation through significant delivery, commissioning, transition or operational change.

# Risk Analyst

At Smart, our mission is to transform retirement, savings and financial wellbeing, across all generations, around the world.

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking an organised and proactive Risk Analyst to join our Risk and Privacy team. Reporting to the Senior Risk Manager, this is a hands-on role at the centre of how Smart looks after personal data day to day. Your focus will be the running of our privacy operations — data subject rights requests, privacy incidents, records of processing, retention and privacy assessments — making sure each is handled properly, on time, and with a clear audit trail.

Smart is supported by outsourced privacy consultants who provide the specialist advice and carry out the detailed work. Your role is to keep the operation running around them — coordinating their input, tracking what they produce and making sure their advice is captured and acted on. Alongside this you will provide administrative and coordination support to the wider team, keeping meetings, actions, reporting and documentation running smoothly. You will work closely with legal, compliance, information security, operations and customer services teams, and with the Data Protection Officer.

You do not need to be highly experienced in data protection to apply — we will train you. What matters is an interest in the subject, a methodical approach, and the judgement to handle sensitive information carefully. We will give you the support and training to build the technical knowledge you need.

Key responsibilities:

**Privacy Operations**

* Manage the day-to-day privacy inbox, triaging incoming queries and either answering them or routing them to the right owner within agreed timescales.
* Coordinate data subject rights requests end to end, tracking each case against the one-month statutory deadline, gathering material from business owners and preparing the response for review.
* Log and track privacy incidents and near misses, gathering the facts and following remediation actions through to closure.
* Maintain the privacy registers and supporting records — including the incident register, the Record of Processing Activities and the DPIA register — so documentation is complete, accurate and audit-ready.
* Support the DPIA process and other project work, running the initial screening, chasing input from business owners and tracking assessments through to sign-off.
* Support the periodic review of privacy notices, policies and procedures, and help track retention and the completion of privacy training.
* Act as a day-to-day point of contact for Smart’s outsourced privacy consultants, coordinating their input, tracking deliverables and making sure their advice is recorded and followed through.
* Help gather evidence for internal and external audits and client assurance requests relating to data protection.
* Prepare the underlying data for periodic privacy reporting, such as incident volumes and data subject rights numbers.

**Team Administration and Support**

* Coordinate the team’s governance calendar — scheduling meetings and forums, preparing agendas and papers, taking minutes and maintaining action logs.
* Track actions and deadlines across the team, following up with owners so items are closed on time.
* Maintain team documentation and records, including version control, document libraries and central registers.
* Prepare and format reporting packs, papers and presentations for senior management and governance forums.
* Provide general administrative support to the team, including diary coordination, purchase orders and supplier onboarding administration.
* Support the onboarding of new team members, and maintain team process notes and how-to guides.
* Contribute to improvements in team processes, templates and trackers to make them simpler and more efficient.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

The skills, experience, and aptitudes we are looking for are listed below but please don’t be discouraged from applying if you don’t meet every single one of these criteria – having a ‘can do’ attitude is sometimes more important than being able to tick every box:

* A genuine interest in data protection and privacy. You do not need to be highly experienced — we will train you. An interest in the subject and an aptitude for it matter more than the number of years on your CV.
* A degree in law, risk management, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Progress towards a privacy or compliance qualification (for example the IAPP CIPP/E, or the Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection) is welcome but not required.
* Some experience in a privacy, risk, compliance, legal, audit, operations or administrative role. Financial services, pensions or fintech experience is helpful but not essential.
* An awareness of UK GDPR concepts — personal data, lawful basis, data subject rights and personal data breaches — or the readiness to pick them up quickly.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to run several cases and workstreams at once, keep tasks moving across teams and meet deadlines without close supervision.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling personal data and maintaining registers and records.
* Sound judgement and discretion, with an understanding of why confidentiality matters when working with sensitive information.
* Good analytical skills, comfortable working with data and turning it into clear, useful reporting.
* Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deal with internal stakeholders and client requests professionally.
* A collaborative, proactive approach — someone who spots what needs doing and picks it up.

**WHO WE ARE**

We work in partnerships with governments and financial institutions in the UK and internationally. Our cloud-native digital platform is revolutionising how people around the world think about, and save for, their retirement.

At heart, we’re a financial technology business. What we do is all about innovation, and using the power of digital change to put the customer first. Our Engineers will tell you that working at Smart gives you the opportunity to play your part in developing world-class technological solutions, working with – and learning from – like-minded people.

You’ll also find that, across our business, our colleagues love Smart’s culture, and how what we do means better financial outcomes for savers. That feels worthwhile, and it means that what we do, collectively, goes way beyond the nine to five of a typical working day.

Don’t just take our word for it – you can see what our colleagues say about working at Smart on LinkedIn Life and Glassdoor.

**BENEFITS**

At Smart, one of the eight principles we work to is “We want happy and good people in our team”. We created a list of benefits that helps us achieve this goal:

* 25 days’ holiday per year, increasing with length of service.
* £500 annual training budget to spend on your professional development
* Extensive private healthcare, including dental, eyecare and EAP
* Enhanced sick leave (three months’ pay per year)
* Enhanced maternity and paternity (maternity – 6 months fully paid/paternity – 3 weeks fully paid)
* Death in service insurance cover
* Fully-paid five-week sabbatical after five years of employment
* In office wellbeing, such as manicures, massages and barbers.
* Smart employees also enjoy a 50% discount on orders from our sister company Arena Flowers, Britain's most ethical florist. They offer unique hand-tied bouquets, luxury flowers, letterbox flowers, plants and gifts to spend on friends and loved ones or even for yourself.

At Smart, we are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work.

We believe that diverse perspectives help us lead the way in transforming retirement, savings, and financial wellbeing. We welcome differences in background, experience, thinking, and identity, and we recognise that innovation is strongest when it is built on inclusion and fairness. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process or in the workplace, we encourage you to let us know - we are committed to supporting you.

We think Smart is an awesome place to work. If it sounds like somewhere you’d like to work, too, and if you’re ready to play your part in our continued success in the future, then naturally we’d love to meet you.

## **The Mission:** **Source.dev**

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the **Android Virtualization Framework**, **Security**, and the **Android Runtime (ART)**.

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

**Source.dev**was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with **SourceFS.**

## **The Core Product: SourceFS**

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

* **10x Faster Builds:** Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.
* **10x Lower Costs:** Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.
* **True Engineering Productivity:** Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

## **The Cultural Anchor: Own It**

We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of **End-to-End Ownership**:

*"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”*

## **The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O**

We are looking for a **Performance / Systems Engineer** to join us at Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.

### **What You’ll Work On**

* **System Bottleneck Hunting:** Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.
* **Kernel & File System Tuning:** Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io\_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.
* **Memory & Cache Efficiency:** Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.
* **Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.
* **Scaling Build Primitives:** Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.

### **Ideal Candidate Profile:**

* **The Performance Systems Mindset:** You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). ***No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for.***
* **Scale-Obsessed:** You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.
* **Impact-Driven:** You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone.
* **Curious & Collaborative:** You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.
* **Low Ego, High Impact:** Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness
* **Feedback Culture Champion:** You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.

## **A Note on Our Search**

We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.

* **Architect the Future:** Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.

*Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. * Collaborate: with customers, vendors, and engineering teams to resolve cases
* Automate: contribute to bot-building and workflow automation
* Document: solutions and improve self-service resources

* Background in Computer Science, IT, networking, or equivalent *hands-on* experience

* API experience: comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, and tools like Postman or cURL
* Linux terminal proficiency: comfortable navigating filesystems, reading logs, and running commands

Description

This role forms part of a multi-disciplinary product squad responsible for delivering digital experiences across a range of insurance products. Working closely with product, design and engineering colleagues, they will help drive high standards of quality, usability and maintainability across the development lifecycle.



Principal accountabilities 
Develop secure, scalable and testable Front-end solutions using modern engineering standards, semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript or TypeScript, and recognised CSS framework best practices to deliver responsive, performant and maintainable user interfaces. 
Design and develop accessible Front-end solutions focusing on semantic HTML structures, complex forms, keyboard interactions, focus management, responsive layouts and dynamically updated user interfaces that meet recognised accessibility standards. 
Collaborate with Product, Design and Engineering colleagues to interpret requirements and translate them into inclusive, high-quality user experiences, using Figma to review designs and agree appropriate implementation solutions. 
Develop and execute automated and manual accessibility testing approaches, contributing to unit, integration and end-to-end test coverage while identifying, diagnosing and resolving accessibility issues across new and existing applications. 
Integrate Front-end applications with APIs, back-end systems and supporting services to deliver robust and seamless customer experiences. 
Create and maintain Storybook stories and documentation to demonstrate accessible, reusable Front-end components. 
Provide practical guidance, code review feedback and mentoring to engineers, promoting high standards of quality, accessibility and maintainability. 
Follow agreed development processes and standards, contribute to their improvement, and fully adopt Agile ways of working while keeping informed of emerging Front-end technologies, accessibility practices and browser capabilities. 
Consider, relevant to your role, the needs and objectives of all our customers, including vulnerable customers, to ensure that they receive good outcomes.



Knowledge, experience and qualifications 
Proven professional experience in Front-end or web development, operating confidently with strong practical knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript or TypeScript and experience using a modern Front-end framework such as React or Vue. 
Advanced knowledge of semantic HTML, accessible forms, validation patterns, keyboard interaction and focus management, with practical application of WCAG 2.x Level AA requirements throughout design, development and testing. 
Experience using automated and manual accessibility testing tools, including browser accessibility tooling, keyboard-only testing and screen readers, with the ability to create accessibility tests and integrate them into wider testing and delivery pipelines. 
Demonstrable experience designing accessible, reusable components in React or Vue, creating and maintaining Storybook component libraries, and managing accessibility across responsive interfaces, dynamic content and single-page applications. 
Experience identifying, prioritising and resolving accessibility issues within existing code base, ensuring solutions remain compliant, maintainable and user focused. 
Good understanding of CSS architecture, CSS frameworks, web application security, performance, browser compatibility, source control and modern development best practices. 
Experience integrating Front-end applications with APIs and working collaboratively with back-end developers, designers, testers, product colleagues and other stakeholders. 
Experience communicating technical concepts clearly and providing guidance, support or mentoring to colleagues.



Behaviours 
Challenge Positively
Acts as a positive Front-end advocate, constructively challenging inaccessible or unsustainable approaches.
Welcomes challenge, takes initiative and demonstrates continuous self-driven learning.
Gives constructive code review feedback and helps colleagues understand the reasoning behind recommended practices. 
Is flexible and adaptable, changing direction where required and learning new technologies and techniques quickly.

Collaborates openly, shares knowledge and patiently mentors developers who are building their Front-end capability. 
Contributes positively to an inclusive, supportive and collaborative team environment. 
Act Decisively

Self-manages workload, balances competing priorities and consistently meets agreed deadlines and delivery targets. 
Takes ownership and accountability for their work and conduct to support good customer outcomes.

This is a full-time Monday to Friday role working an average 37.5 hours per week.

responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

# Customer Success Analyst

Belfast, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom

**Join TRG Screen: Building World-Class Teams. One Expert at a Time.**

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team at the forefront of subscription spend management innovation?

At TRG Screen, we're not just redefining how organizations manage their subscription expenses – we're shaping the future of the industry. With cutting-edge solutions and a commitment to excellence, we empower businesses around the globe to optimize their subscription investments and drive sustainable growth.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize subscription management and make a meaningful impact on the way businesses access and utilize critical information. At TRG Screen, your talent and ambition will find a home, where opportunities for growth and advancement abound.

**About TRG Screen**

TRG Screen is the leading provider of market data and subscription management technology and automation solutions, tailored to the unique needs of financial institutions and legal firms. Our integrated suite of solutions includes market data and subscription spend management, usage management, compliance reporting, and comprehensive managed services, which hundreds of clients worldwide use to remove cumbersome and inaccurate manual processes and gain control over market data and subscription costs at scale. For more than 25 years, TRG Screen has enabled businesses who rely on market data to monitor and strategically manage spending and usage of data and information services, including market data, research, software licenses, consulting and other necessary corporate expenses. TRG Screen solutions give decisionmakers full transparency into subscription spend and usage, enabling them to proactively manage subscription costs at scale, conduct more informed vendor negotiations, improve governance, and avoid unnecessary spending on these mission-critical business services. TRG Screen is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Europe and Asia, as well as a 24x7 client support center in Bangalore, India.

TRG Screen is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, one of the world’s largest and most respected private equity firms.

**Customer Success Manager**

**\*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work core hours of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM UK time.\***

## ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Customer Success Manager, you will work directly with customers to ensure they have realized maximum value from our platform. Working in partnership with Customer Care, Sales, Professional Services, and Managed Services teams, you will help our customers achieve business goals and program impact while driving retention and growth for TRG Screen.

You will be responsible for delivering an optimal customer experience, fostering positive customer outcomes, delivering proactive recommendations, and driving ongoing business impact. This role is ideal for candidates with customer-facing experience, analytics/data operations backgrounds, or strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

You will support both Financial segment customers (banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and other enterprise financial institutions) and Legal segment customers (law firms and legal services organizations), managing market data workflows, compliance requirements, data operations, and operational efficiency. You will amplify the voice of the customer internally by driving continuous feedback into cross-functional teams on ways we can better serve our customers.

**\*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work core hours of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM UK time.\***

## MISSION

Our mission is to help customers realize the full value of their TRG Screen investment by turning complex operational challenges into efficient, compliant, and scalable solutions. We partner with customers to reduce friction, improve visibility and adoption, and deliver measurable business value and ROI.

For our customers across both segments, this means helping transform manual, error-prone processes into streamlined, auditable systems that reduce risk, improve efficiency, and empower teams to focus on work that matters most.

CSMs develop a deep understanding of customer goals, identifying innovative solutions which align to desired platform outcomes. You will partner with customers to value realization to ensure customers are achieving their identified business outcomes.

When our customers realize success, TRG realizes success via high customer satisfaction, growth, and retention. Key areas of emphasis and success indicators for our CSMs include:

* Retention: Retain recurring revenue in customer portfolio while actively monitoring usage and compliance health to identify at-risk accounts early
* Positive Customer Experience: Build customer usage, adoption, and perceived ROI by delivering an optimized customer experience and proving value throughout the customer journey—with particular emphasis on operational efficiency and regulatory compliance
* Account Health & Risk Management: Monitor usage patterns, data quality, and contract compliance within customer portfolios. Proactively identify at-risk customers and execute on heal plays to retain the customer and improve overall account health. Drive expansion through upselling of adjacent workflows, not just feature adoption.
* **\*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work core hours of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM UK time.\***

## REQUIRED SKILLS & CAPABILITIES

* Proven track-record of helping customers drive sustained product adoption, customer satisfaction, and overall customer health
* Effective at establishing credibility and influencing executive and operational leadership within large enterprise organizations
* Skilled relationship builder who can develop trusted, multi-level relationships across key stakeholders (IT, operations, procurement, technical) within customer organizations
* Proven ability to proactively nurture customer accounts to identify revenue expansion opportunities and ensure successful renewals
* Understanding of the customer journey and experience serving as a strategic advisor in translating customers' goals into outcomes through ownership and execution of a customer success plan
* Ability to prioritize accounts to focus efforts based on perceived risk, potential growth, strategic value, and renewal timeframe
* Well-versed in communicating value and guiding customers to achieve their defined business objectives
* Ability to translate product functionality into business impact—comfortable discussing data lineage, accuracy, analytical validation and reporting with both technical and business stakeholders
* Can empathize with customers and stakeholders at all levels, with an ability to convert empathy into advocacy
* Ability to solve complex challenges independently and confidently
* Extensive experience leading effective and consistent customer Business Reviews based on defined rubric
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* **\*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work core hours of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM UK time.\***

### TECHNICAL FLUENCY

* Comfortable reviewing data and usage reports and explaining findings to customers
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools (e.g., for account insights, meeting intelligence, or workflow automation) and comfort utilizing these tools in a daily workflow

## BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE (Preferred)

* Background in mathematics, analytics, science, data operations, or related analytical fields preferred
* Experience working within complex, highly regulated markets
* Previous experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

## CHARACTERISTICS THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL POSSESS

* Curiosity
* Bias for action
* Resiliency
* Strong time management skills
* Comfort with ambiguity in data-driven problem solving
* Strong analytical and quantitative thinking skills
* Comfortable adopting AI-assisted tools to increase productivity and focus more time on strategic customer conversations. We expect CSMs to integrate these tools into daily workflows.
* Travel 25% annually for strategic customer meetings and team offsites
* **\*Note: This role supports US-based clients and requires candidates to work core hours of 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM UK time.\***

We're responsible for ensuring that clients have an amazing experience with TRG Screen. We are dedicated to every user's success and address challenges quickly and creatively.

We act as staunch advocates for our clients, including identifying and responding to diverse client use cases. We take pride in developing personal relationships with our users and our team.

£32,000 - £33,000 GBP

We recognise and value the power of diversity in our workplace and are committed to being an employer of choice for everyone. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds. All applications for employment are considered strictly on the basis of merit.

Intern

## Company Description

Meet Unit4. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid-market people-centric organisations.

With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.

At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters. A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.

We’re shaping how work should feel, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.

## Job Description

**About this internship**

For most of its history, software engineering has been the work of translation. A person who understood a problem handed it to a person who could write code, and the second person turned that understanding into instructions a machine would follow. The instructions were the artifact. The understanding lived upstream and rarely survived the trip intact.

That arrangement is ending. Software can now generate working code from a clear description of what it should do and why. The scarce skill is no longer writing the instructions. It is stating the intent precisely enough that the rest can be handed to a machine. This is what spec-driven development means, and it changes who is good at this work.

Stating intent well is not a coding skill. It is the ability to understand a problem, and to understand your own understanding of it at one level above. To notice an assumption nobody made explicit. To find ambiguity in a sentence before it becomes a defect. To know what a request means and not only what it says. Philosophy, psychology, linguistics, law, and design train these habits as deliberately as computer science trains data structures.

So, this internship is open to students from any field. We are interested in how you think, rather than the specific field you come from.

**What you would work on**

* Turn real business and technical problems into clear specifications a development system can act on.
* Work on the part that comes before the code, namely what the software should do, for whom, and what would count as getting it right.
* Collaborate with engineers, designers, and domain experts in an international team, working in English.
* Use AI tools to move from intent to a working solution and learn where they help and where they fail.
* Document the reasoning behind decisions so the thinking survives, not only the result.

**Who we are looking for**

We are not looking for a finished engineer. We are looking for a way of thinking.

**You must be enrolled at the University of Granada and be eligible for an internship through ICARO**

* A student in any Bachelor's or Master's program, in the humanities, social sciences, design, or a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) field.
* The habit of asking what a problem actually is before reaching a solution.
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the patience to make it precise.
* An interest in how AI is changing the way software gets built.
* A good level of written and spoken English.

**Helpful, but not required**

* Some experience building things in any medium, whether code, research design, structured argument, or written work.
* Familiarity with AI or machine learning tools, or simple curiosity about them.
* Experience explaining complex ideas to people who do not share your background.

**What we offer**

* Real projects with real impact, with engineers and mentors working alongside you.
* A close look at how enterprise software is being rebuilt around intent rather than instructions.
* An international and multidisciplinary environment.
* Flexibility around the requirements of your studies.
* Room to develop in a field that is being redefined right now.

**A note on what this is really about**

Software used to ask people to think like machines, step by step, in the order the machine required. That is the part that is ending. The work that matters now sits upstream of the code, in the clarity of what we are trying to build and why. If you are studying how people think, how language carries meaning, how arguments hold together, or how systems behave, you have been preparing for this without calling it that. We would like to hear from you.

## Qualifications

* Psychology or the social sciences
* Design, human-computer interaction, or communication
* Computer science, software engineering, or data science
* Mathematics, physics, or any engineering discipline

**TLDR:** Plinth builds software for charities, foundations and funders. 13,000+ UK organisations use us, we add 7+ clients a month, and we ship constantly. You'll be the first person customers reach, but you'll be judged on whether fewer of them need to reach you next quarter, and on being able to prove it. You'll also own free Plinth, which exists because it's good for the sector and because it's where we learn fastest. A strong first or second job: you'll touch support, product, engineering and operations in your first month.

## What you'll own

* **Your own workload.** You start as first responder in Intercom, and your job is to make that role smaller every quarter. Falling volume with rising satisfaction is the metric, not tickets closed
* **Measurement.** PostHog, Intercom and Linear are yours: the ticket tagging that makes volume analysable, the dashboards showing where users get stuck, the view of whether fixes shipped and queries stopped. Right now we can't see our own support data clearly enough to know if we're improving. That's your problem to solve
* **Free Plinth.** Thousands of small charities who could never afford software like this get it anyway, and they test new functionality at volume. You own their experience and argue their case internally, and know when it will make the product better for everyone.
* **Self-serve.** Help articles, in-app guidance, website content and the chatbot behind them. A product with an audience, not a wiki that gets tidied when things are quiet
* **Support tooling.** Find the queries that shouldn't need a human, then build or spec the thing that removes them: a status page, a clearer error message, an automation, a self-serve action. You're expected to spot it, make the case and see it land
* **The loop into product.** Recommendations backed by evidence, not anecdote: here's the query volume, here's the funnel showing where it starts, here's what we change, here's how we'll know it worked. Then follow it until the cause is fixed, not the symptom
* **Escalation and response.** Customers hear back in minutes, not tomorrow, and stay informed until it's genuinely resolved

## What we're looking for

* You work without handholding. We'll give you context and a clear idea of what good looks like, not a daily list
* Repetition bothers you. Answering the same question by hand for the tenth time should feel like a bug you own
* You think past the ticket in front of you: why did this reach me at all, and what would stop the next fifty
* You reach for a number rather than a feeling. You don't need to arrive knowing PostHog, just to enjoy turning a messy pile of tickets into a chart that settles an argument
* You'll advocate for users internally, including the ones who don't pay us
* You're properly organised. Tickets, escalations, half-written articles and an invoice query all live at once, nothing quietly dropped
* You write clearly and fast, to stressed non-technical people. Warm, unpatronising, honest when something's broken
* You've run something yourself: a society, a side project, a process you rebuilt in a part-time job
* Charity sector experience and technical confidence are both real advantages

## What good looks like after a year

* The top recurring queries from your first month no longer exist
* Support volume per customer has fallen while the company has grown, and we can see it on a dashboard you built
* Anyone at Plinth can answer "are we getting better at support?" in thirty seconds
* You can point at paid features that shipped better because free users hit the problems first

**Recent graduates welcome.** We care more about how you think, write and organise yourself than what you've done before. If you want ownership rather than a narrow lane, this offers more range in a year than most graduate schemes manage in three.

# Customer Success Manager

## **🌍 About us**

Plinth is a fast-growing tech startup working with charities, foundations and local government. Small and local charities are highly effective but largely hidden. They have no spare time and no spare money. We're building the tools these organisations need and shining a light on the work they do. Read more on our blog.

**🚀We're growing fast.** 3-4x this year. We get 7+ new clients a month and we're shipping new features every few days. This means things move quickly and your work directly shapes how we scale. You'll have real responsibility from day one.

**❤️It's really impactful work.** Our clients are charities and grassroots organisations across the UK, and soon internationally. When you help them succeed with our platform, you're directly amplifying their impact. Every successful onboarding means a charity spends less time fighting with their systems and more time on their actual mission.

**🤝You'll work with impressive people.** Our team is talented, collaborative and slightly strange(?). We value impact, speed and openness. We work in person in our office in Old Street because we genuinely enjoy each other's company (most of the time). It’s a high trust, creative space where if you think something's a good idea, you just go do it.

## **💼 You need to be able to:**

* **Work both fast and slow:** You'll navigate slow public sector procurement cycles one minute, then help us ship a new feature over lunch the next. The whiplash is intense but it keeps things interesting.
* **Keep it real:** You'll be getting the train to community centres and youth clubs where the heating doesn't work and where the paint is peeling off the walls. It’s rarely glamourous. You need to be willing to meet clients where they are, literally and figuratively.
* **Listen to problems, ignore solutions:** Clients will tell you exactly what they think they need. Your job is to understand the actual problem and guide them to what will really work, even when they're convinced they already know the answer. This requires self-confidence, understanding of the platform and genuine listening in equal measure.
* **Teach people:** Most of our clients don't love shiny gadgets. If you're the kind of person who enjoys teaching your gran to use a smartphone, this is ideal. You need to explain some fairly complex systems clearly without being condescending and still getting user adoption
* **Automate and document yourself away:🤖** We're small and growing fast. Build systems and processes that make your job increasingly redundant. There’s always plenty more to do.
* **Understand the difference between "urgent" and 🚨 URGENT** — When you're managing 4-8 concurrent client projects and everyone thinks their issue is critical, you need to distinguish between what must happen for launch versus what can wait. This is harder than it sounds.
* **Grow with the role:** we need someone who is comfortable with our clients and team doubling every 6 months. Your role will rapidly change to reflect that, but it leaves you with lots of room to grow in responsibility.

## **🧩 What kind of background do we think would be a good fit?**

We’d expect a few years experience in something like the following:

* **Coaching / Tutoring:** You know how to meet people where they are and guide them to better outcomes
* **Hospitality management:** Service mindset, de-escalation skills, managing expectations when things don't go to plan, letting the customer think they’re right when they aren’t
* **Event/production management**: Used to juggling moving pieces, keeping stakeholders calm, making last-minute pivots when things go wrong
* **Community organising/activism:** Already comfortable in the spaces you'll be visiting, get the mission, used to working with limited resources
* **Consulting:** You're used to parachuting into chaos, extracting actionable tasks, and keeping multiple clients calm simultaneously
* **User research/UX:** Good at understanding what people actually need versus what they say they need, synthesising feedback into actionable insights
* Knowledge of the charity sector is a significant advantage, whether that’s as an employee, consultant or as a long term volunteer.
* It would also definitely be helpful if you have any technical experience to help with managing data migrations.

**Importantly, This is a list of suggestions.**

If you have experience in only some of this, or have only some of these skills, please do apply anyway.

## **📈 How can you measure your success?**

* **Speed of getting customers successfully using Plinth:** From signed contract to actively using the platform and seeing value.
* **Positive recommendations:** Clients recommending us positively to their networks — it’s a big source of our growth.
* **Increasing use of Plinth:** Clients expanding how they use the platform over time, not just maintaining baseline usage

## **🧠 The role**

**Client Onboarding (70%)** — Lead onboarding from kick-off to go-live. Break down complex projects into clear phases. Manage timelines, priorities, and expectations across 7+ new clients per month. Stay on top of new features we ship every few days. Push back when needed and teach anyone regardless of background.

**Operations & Process Improvement (30%)** — Audit and optimise our support systems (expect to manage Intercom chat a couple of days a week). Refine onboarding workflows. Keep documentation current. Work with engineering to communicate what's urgent versus what's just a problem. Track feature requests across clients and synthesise them into product improvements.

## **💵 What we offer**

* **Salary:** £42,000 - £75,000 depending on experience
* **Equity** as part of your package
* **Location:** In-person, Old Street, London

2. First interview with Chris and a co-founder
3. Long (2-3 hour), quite intense, in-person interview — meet the team, do tasks, respond to case studies, be challenged
4. Decision

**Job Title: Senior Brand and Artist Operations and Logistics Project Manager**

**Company: WMX**

**Role Overview**

As the Brand and Artist Operations and Logistics Project Manager, you are the operational backbone of our merchandise and experiential campaigns. You will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end execution of large-scale merchandise projects for high-profile artists, with a specific focus on the operations and logistics of executing high-impact pop-up shops and experiences.

 

You will own the administrative frameworks, manage complex budgets, supplier networks, manager 3rd party relationships and drive cross-functional alignment. Your goal is to ensure that every physical merchandise project is delivered flawlessly, on time, and on budget, turning creative vision into commercial reality with second to none administration and communication to all stakeholders. 

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Campaign Execution**

• Project Ownership: Oversee the complete lifecycle of large-scale merchandise campaigns from the moment of final creative approval through to consumer delivery.

• Pop-Up & Experiential Focus: Take the operational lead on bespoke physical pop-up shops (build-outs, staffing, POS systems) Operations, Logistics &

**Administration**

• Administrative Frameworks: Build, maintain, and own all critical project documentation, including master administrative tracking sheets, critical paths, supplier setup and payments summaries supported by production, legal and finance. Take a lead on working with with department heads and monthly budget updates for finance teams. 

• Buying & Inventory: Create and manage accurate buying sheets. Oversee inventory management to ensure optimal stock levels across all sales channels, avoiding overstock or out-of-stock scenarios.

• Global Logistics: Coordinate complex logistics, ensuring goods are shipped, tracked, and delivered seamlessly to global warehouses, physical retail partners, or pop-up locations.

• Responsible for ensuring all suppliers and partners are contracted and setup. 

**Financial & Budget Management**

• Budget Tracking: Manage project budgets meticulously, tracking all production, freight, marketing, and operational costs.

• Margin Control: Work closely with production and brand teams to ensure projects remain commercially viable and hit predefined margin and profitability targets.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Communication**

• Meeting Facilitation: Schedule and lead regular project status meetings, acting as the central hub of information for all internal stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Drive cross-functional collaboration, ensuring deadlines are met across Creative, Production, Brand Management, PR, Marketing, and E-commerce teams.

• Troubleshooting: Act as the first line of defence for logistical or operational roadblocks, proactively solving problems before they impact the project timeline or consumer experience.

**Requirements & Skills**

• Project Management Experience: Proven experience (typically 5+years) in project management or operations, ideally within merchandise, events, retail, fashion, or music.

• Logistical Mastermind: A deep understanding of supply chain, inventory management, global shipping, and the specific operational needs of both physical pop-ups and e-commerce platforms.

• Highly Analytical & Organized: Exceptional administrative skills with advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets. You must love building spreadsheets, tracking data, and creating order out of chaos.

• Financial Literacy: Strong ability to build, manage, and reconcile complex project budgets.

* **Support the evaluation and implementation of new marketing technology and**

* **Improve our understanding of both marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline.**
* **Identify and resolve attribution and tracking issues.**
* **Ensure campaign data is structured in a way that enables reliable ROI and pipeline reporting.**

**You'll turn marketing and funnel data into actionable insight.**

**You will:**

* **Build and maintain dashboards covering MQL generation, conversion, pipeline contribution, campaign performance and funnel health.**
* **Monitor key marketing operational KPIs and proactively flag areas of concern.**
* **Analyse conversion between funnel stages and identify opportunities to improve performance.**
* **Provide Marketing leadership with reliable reporting on campaign and channel effectiveness.**
* **Partner with RevOps to ensure Marketing and Sales are working from consistent definitions and datasets.**
* **Support analysis of marketing ROI and pipeline contribution.**
* **Investigate discrepancies in reporting and resolve underlying data issues.**
* **Use AI and automation to make analysis faster, identify trends and anomalies, and surface insights that might otherwise be missed.**
* **Help move the organisation from reporting what happened to understanding why it happened and what we should do next.**

### **Data Quality & Governance**

**You'll help ensure we can trust the data underpinning our GTM decisions.**

**You will:**

* **Monitor and improve contact, account and campaign data quality.**
* **Establish processes to prevent duplicates and incomplete or inconsistent records.**
* **Define required fields and validation rules where appropriate.**
* **Regularly audit marketing data and workflows.**
* **Ensure data is synchronising correctly between platforms.**
* **Work with RevOps to establish clear ownership and governance across GTM data.**

If two dashboards show different numbers, you need to understand why.**

**You automate.  
If someone is repeatedly doing something manually, your instinct is to ask whether the system should be doing it instead.**

**You're AI curious.

**You think end-to-end.

You’ll combine user research, voice-of-customer insight and behavioural data with a fast-paced optimisation mindset — taking ideas from initial concept to high-quality, testable prototypes in days rather than weeks.
AI will be a fundamental part of how you work. You’ll use it as a force multiplier to explore more ideas, accelerate prototyping and validate assumptions faster. You’ll also lead the development of an AI-enabled design system that helps dramatically reduce the time between having an idea and getting genuine customer feedback.
Success isn't measured by how many screens you design. It's measured by how quickly you help us discover what works and how effectively those learnings help more customers successfully finance a car through Zuto.

Turning ideas into high-quality prototypes at exceptional speed, helping teams move from concept to customer feedback in days rather than weeks.
Creating customer journeys, wireframes, user flows and prototypes that make ideas tangible and easy to test.
Translating customer problems, commercial opportunities and product hypotheses into experiences customers can genuinely interact with.
Using strong UX and interaction design principles to create intuitive, simple and effective customer journeys.
Rapidly iterating designs based on insight, experimentation and customer feedback.
AI-Native Design & Systems
Using AI tools every day to accelerate ideation, prototyping, content creation, interaction design and design production.
Building and evolving an AI-enabled design system designed around rapid experimentation and reusable patterns.
Creating systems and processes that allow teams to move from idea to customer validation significantly faster.
Continuously exploring emerging AI capabilities, tools and workflows that increase design velocity and reduce unnecessary effort.
Helping shape what an AI-native product and design function looks like at Zuto.
Experimentation & Product Collaboration
Working closely with Product, Marketing, Partnerships and Data to identify opportunities, shape experiments and improve customer outcomes.
Partnering with our Conversion & Experimentation capability to turn hypotheses into experiences that can be rapidly tested.
Using customer insight, behavioural data and experimentation results to continuously refine experiences.

Using evidence rather than opinion to inform design decisions.
Customer Experience & Insight
Developing a deep understanding of our customers, their motivations, behaviours and the barriers they experience.
Combining user research, customer feedback and behavioural data to identify opportunities for improvement.
Championing the customer throughout the design and experimentation process.
Ensuring design decisions balance customer needs with commercial outcomes.
Identifying friction within existing journeys and designing simpler, more effective experiences.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong UX fundamentals with speed, curiosity and a genuine desire to experiment.

Proven experience designing digital products and customer experiences.

AI Fluency

You'll constantly explore how AI can help you move faster, reduce manual design work, generate and test more ideas and ultimately shorten the journey from idea → prototype → customer feedback → learning.
